648: // Start prepares and starts the site, then publishes routes. It is idempotent:
649: // preparing and starting an already running site succeeds.
650: func (s *Service) Start(ctx context.Context, ref string) error {
651: 	ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
652: 
653: 	s.mu.Lock()
654: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
655: 
656: 	if err := s.checkDeps(true, false); err != nil {
657: 		return err
658: 	}
659: 	site, err := s.resolveLocked(ctx, ref)
660: 	if err != nil {
661: 		return err
662: 	}
663: 	started, err := s.startLocked(ctx, site)
664: 	if err != nil {
665: 		return err
666: 	}
667: 	if err := s.rebuildRoutesLocked(ctx); err != nil {
668: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: publish routes for %q: %w", site.Name, err)
669: 	}
670: 	if s.externalServing() && started.Kind != model.SiteStatic {
671: 		if err := s.syncVhostsLocked(ctx, ""); err != nil {
672: 			cause := fmt.Errorf("sites: publish vhost for %q: %w", site.Name, err)
673: 			if started.DesiredState != site.DesiredState || started.Status != site.Status {
674: 				return errors.Join(cause, s.restoreSiteStateLocked(ctx, site, started))
675: 			}
676: 			return cause
677: 		}
678: 	}
679: 	return nil
680: }
681: 
682: // Stop terminates the backend process, records the stopped state, and
683: // republishes routes.
684: func (s *Service) Stop(ctx context.Context, ref string) error {
685: 	ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
686: 
687: 	s.mu.Lock()
688: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
689: 
690: 	if err := s.checkDeps(true, false); err != nil {
691: 		return err
692: 	}
693: 	site, err := s.resolveLocked(ctx, ref)
694: 	if err != nil {
695: 		return err
696: 	}
697: 	stopped, err := s.stopLocked(ctx, site)
698: 	if err != nil {
699: 		return err
700: 	}
701: 	if err := s.rebuildRoutesLocked(ctx); err != nil {
702: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: publish routes for %q: %w", site.Name, err)
703: 	}
704: 	if s.externalServing() && stopped.Kind != model.SiteStatic {
705: 		if err := s.syncVhostsLocked(ctx, ""); err != nil {
706: 			cause := fmt.Errorf("sites: publish vhost for %q: %w", site.Name, err)
707: 			if stopped.DesiredState != site.DesiredState || stopped.Status != site.Status {
708: 				return errors.Join(cause, s.restoreSiteStateLocked(ctx, site, stopped))
709: 			}
710: 			return cause
711: 		}
712: 	}
713: 	return nil
714: }
715: 
716: // Restart stops and starts a site. The route snapshot is rebuilt once after
717: // the new process is running.
718: func (s *Service) Restart(ctx context.Context, ref string) error {
719: 	ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
720: 
721: 	s.mu.Lock()
722: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
723: 
724: 	if err := s.checkDeps(true, false); err != nil {
725: 		return err
726: 	}
727: 	site, err := s.resolveLocked(ctx, ref)
728: 	if err != nil {
729: 		return err
730: 	}
731: 	previous := site
732: 	site, err = s.stopLocked(ctx, site)
733: 	if err != nil {
734: 		return err
735: 	}
736: 	site, err = s.startLocked(ctx, site)
737: 	if err != nil {
738: 		// The stop succeeded but the start did not. Preserve desired=running so
739: 		// daemon reconciliation retries instead of silently staying stopped.
740: 		restarting := site
741: 		restarting.DesiredState = model.DesiredRunning
742: 		if restarting.Status == "" || restarting.Status == model.StatusStopped {
743: 			restarting.Status = model.StatusError
744: 		}
745: 		restarting.UpdatedAt = s.currentTime()
746: 		if saveErr := s.deps.Store.UpdateSite(ctx, restarting); saveErr != nil {
747: 			return fmt.Errorf("sites: restart %q: %w (also failed to preserve desired state: %v)", site.Name, err, saveErr)
748: 		}
749: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: restart %q: %w", site.Name, err)
750: 	}
751: 	if err := s.rebuildRoutesLocked(ctx); err != nil {
752: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: publish routes for %q: %w", site.Name, err)
753: 	}
754: 	if s.externalServing() && site.Kind != model.SiteStatic {
755: 		if err := s.syncVhostsLocked(ctx, ""); err != nil {
756: 			cause := fmt.Errorf("sites: publish vhost for %q: %w", site.Name, err)
757: 			return errors.Join(cause, s.restoreSiteStateLocked(ctx, previous, site))
758: 		}
759: 	}
760: 	return nil
761: }
762: 
763: // Delete stops the site, removes its hosts entries, certificate, and row, and
764: // releases its ports. If the hosts sync fails the stopped row is kept so a
765: // retry can finish the deletion.
766: func (s *Service) Delete(ctx context.Context, ref string) error {
767: 	ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
768: 
769: 	s.mu.Lock()
770: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
771: 
772: 	if err := s.checkDeps(true, true); err != nil {
773: 		return err
774: 	}
775: 	site, err := s.resolveLocked(ctx, ref)
776: 	if err != nil {
777: 		return err
778: 	}
779: 	if s.externalServing() {
780: 		return s.deleteExternalLocked(ctx, site)
781: 	}
782: 	site, err = s.stopLocked(ctx, site)
783: 	if err != nil {
784: 		return err
785: 	}
786: 
787: 	remaining, err := s.hostsFor(ctx, site.ID, nil)
788: 	if err != nil {
789: 		return err
790: 	}
791: 	if err := s.syncHosts(ctx, remaining); err != nil {
792: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: sync hosts before deleting %q: %w", site.Name, err)
793: 	}
794: 
795: 	if err := s.deps.Certs.Delete(ctx, site.ID); err != nil {
796: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: delete certificate for %q: %w", site.Name, err)
797: 	}
798: 	if err := s.deps.Store.DeleteSite(ctx, site.ID); err != nil {
799: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: delete %q: %w", site.Name, err)
800: 	}
801: 	s.emitEvent(ctx, site.ID, "site.deleted", fmt.Sprintf("site %s deleted", site.Name))
802: 
803: 	s.releasePort(ctx, site.ID, site.HTTPPort)
804: 	if site.FastCGIPort != 0 {
805: 		s.releasePort(ctx, site.ID, site.FastCGIPort)
806: 	}
807: 	var removeErr error
808: 	if site.Kind == model.SitePHP {
809: 		removeErr = s.removePHPConfigLocked(site.ID)
810: 	}
811: 
812: 	if err := s.rebuildRoutesLocked(ctx); err != nil {
813: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: publish routes after deleting %q: %w", site.Name, err)
814: 	}
815: 	if removeErr != nil {
816: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: remove PHP config for %q: %w", site.Name, removeErr)
817: 	}
818: 	return nil
819: }
820: 
821: // newSite validates a create request and builds the row that will be
822: // persisted. It performs no external side effects.
823: func (s *Service) newSite(ctx context.Context, req CreateRequest) (model.Site, error) {
824: 	name, err := domain.NormalizeName(strings.TrimSpace(req.Name))
825: 	if err != nil {
826: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: %w", err)
827: 	}
828: 	kind := model.SiteKind(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.Kind)))
829: 	switch kind {
830: 	case model.SiteStatic, model.SiteNode, model.SitePHP:
831: 	default:
832: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: unsupported site kind %q", req.Kind)
833: 	}
834: 
835: 	sourceMode := model.SourceMode(strings.TrimSpace(req.SourceMode))
836: 	if sourceMode == "" {
837: 		sourceMode = pathmode.DefaultSourceMode(kind, runtime.GOOS)
838: 	}
839: 	if err := pathmode.ValidateSourceMode(sourceMode, runtime.GOOS); err != nil {
840: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: %w", err)
841: 	}
842: 	hostPath, backendPath, err := pathmode.TranslateSourceForDistro(sourceMode, req.Path, s.deps.Config.WSLDistro)
843: 	if err != nil {
844: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: %w", err)
845: 	}
846: 	project := hostPath
847: 	if sourceMode == model.SourceLocal {
848: 		project, err = domain.ValidateProjectPath(req.Path)
849: 		if err != nil {
850: 			return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: %w", err)
851: 		}
852: 		hostPath, backendPath = project, project
853: 	}
854: 	if kind != model.SitePHP {
855: 		if err := rejectPHPOnlyCreateFields(req); err != nil {
856: 			return model.Site{}, err
857: 		}
858: 	}
859: 
860: 	siteDomain := domain.DomainFor(name)
861: 	if err := domain.ValidateSiteDomain(siteDomain); err != nil {
862: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: invalid domain %q: %w", siteDomain, err)
863: 	}
864: 
865: 	if _, err := s.deps.Store.GetSiteByName(ctx, name); err == nil {
866: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: site name %q already exists", name)
867: 	} else if !errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
868: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: check name %q: %w", name, err)
869: 	}
870: 
871: 	fcFile := strings.TrimSpace(req.FrontControllerFile)
872: 	if fcFile == "" {
873: 		fcFile = "index.php"
874: 	}
875: 	if err := validateFrontControllerFile(fcFile); err != nil {
876: 		return model.Site{}, err
877: 	}
878: 
879: 	fcMode := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.FrontControllerMode))
880: 	if fcMode == "" {
881: 		fcMode = "auto"
882: 	}
883: 	if err := validateFrontControllerMode(fcMode); err != nil {
884: 		return model.Site{}, err
885: 	}
886: 
887: 	override := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.ApacheAllowOverride))
888: 	if override == "" {
889: 		override = "all"
890: 	}
891: 	if err := validateApacheAllowOverride(override); err != nil {
892: 		return model.Site{}, err
893: 	}
894: 
895: 	spaFile := strings.TrimSpace(req.SPAFallbackFile)
896: 	if spaFile == "" {
897: 		spaFile = "index.html"
898: 	}
899: 	if err := validateSPAFallbackFile(spaFile); err != nil {
900: 		return model.Site{}, err
901: 	}
902: 
903: 	if err := validateBuildProfile(req.Build); err != nil {
904: 		return model.Site{}, err
905: 	}
906: 	if err := validateSiteEnvironment(req.Env); err != nil {
907: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: %w", err)
908: 	}
909: 
910: 	site := model.Site{
911: 		Name:                name,
912: 		Domain:              siteDomain,
913: 		WWW:                 req.WWW,
914: 		Backend:             model.BackendLocal,
915: 		SourceMode:          sourceMode,
916: 		HostPath:            hostPath,
917: 		BackendPath:         backendPath,
918: 		Kind:                kind,
919: 		NodeVersion:         strings.TrimSpace(req.NodeVersion),
920: 		Command:             strings.TrimSpace(req.Command),
921: 		Env:                 cloneEnv(req.Env),
922: 		DocumentRoot:        strings.TrimSpace(req.DocumentRoot),
923: 		FrontControllerFile: fcFile,
924: 		FrontControllerMode: fcMode,
925: 		ApacheAllowOverride: override,
926: 		SPAFallback:         req.SPAFallback,
927: 		SPAFallbackFile:     spaFile,
928: 		Build:               cloneBuildProfile(req.Build),
929: 		TLS:                 req.TLS,
930: 		ForceHTTPS:          req.ForceHTTPS,
931: 		DesiredState:        model.DesiredRunning,
932: 	}
933: 
934: 	switch kind {
935: 	case model.SiteStatic:
936: 		// A build profile's output is the public document root unless the
937: 		// caller explicitly selected a different directory. The output may not
938: 		// exist until the first build, so validate its shape here and let the
939: 		// backend resolve it when the site starts.
940: 		if site.Build != nil && strings.TrimSpace(req.DocumentRoot) == "" && strings.TrimSpace(site.Build.Output) != "" {
941: 			site.DocumentRoot = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(site.Build.Output))
942: 			break
943: 		}
944: 		site.DocumentRoot, err = resolveSiteDocumentRoot(site, req.DocumentRoot)
945: 		if err != nil {
946: 			return model.Site{}, err
947: 		}
948: 	case model.SiteNode:
949: 		if strings.TrimSpace(req.DocumentRoot) != "" {
950: 			return model.Site{}, errors.New("sites: node sites do not use a document root")
951: 		}
952: 		if site.NodeVersion == "" {
953: 			return model.Site{}, errors.New("sites: node site requires a version")
954: 		}
955: 		if site.Command == "" {
956: 			return model.Site{}, errors.New("sites: node site requires a command")
957: 		}
958: 	case model.SitePHP:
959: 		site.PHPVersion = strings.TrimSpace(req.PHPVersion)
960: 		site.PHPBuild = strings.TrimSpace(req.PHPBuild)
961: 		if site.PHPVersion == "" {
962: 			return model.Site{}, errors.New("sites: php site requires a version")
963: 		}
964: 		if !supportedPHPLine(site.PHPVersion) {
965: 			return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: unsupported PHP version %q (want 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, or 8.5)", site.PHPVersion)
966: 		}
967: 		site.PHPExtensions = cloneBoolMap(req.PHPExtensions)
968: 		site.PHPIni = cloneStringMap(req.PHPIni)
969: 		site.PHPIniRaw = strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(req.PHPIniRaw, "\r\n", "\n"), "\r", "\n")
970: 		site.FrontController = req.FrontController
971: 		site.DocumentRoot, err = resolveSiteDocumentRoot(site, req.DocumentRoot)
972: 		if err != nil {
973: 			return model.Site{}, err
974: 		}
975: 		if err := phpini.ValidateOverrides(site.PHPIni); err != nil {
976: 			return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: php.ini overrides: %w", err)
977: 		}
978: 		if err := phpini.ValidateRaw(site.PHPIniRaw); err != nil {
979: 			return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: raw php.ini: %w", err)
980: 		}
981: 		manifest, err := s.phpCatalog()
982: 		if err != nil {
983: 			return model.Site{}, err
984: 		}
985: 		if _, err := manifest.Resolve(site.PHPVersion, site.PHPExtensions); err != nil {
986: 			return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: PHP extensions: %w", err)
987: 		}
988: 		build, err := s.resolvePHPBuildLocked(ctx, site.PHPVersion, site.PHPBuild)
989: 		if err != nil {
990: 			return model.Site{}, err
991: 		}
992: 		site.PHPBuild = build.ID
993: 	}
994: 
995: 	if site.NodeVersion != "" {
996: 		resolved, err := s.resolveNodePin(ctx, site.NodeVersion)
997: 		if err != nil {
998: 			return model.Site{}, err
999: 		}
1000: 		site.NodeVersion = resolved
1001: 	}
1002: 
1003: 	if err := s.ensureDomainsAvailable(ctx, "", siteDomains(site)); err != nil {
1004: 		return model.Site{}, err
1005: 	}
1006: 
1007: 	id := strings.TrimSpace(s.deps.NewID())
1008: 	if id == "" {
1009: 		return model.Site{}, errors.New("sites: generated site id is empty")
1010: 	}
1011: 	site.ID = id
1012: 	return site, nil
1013: }
1014: 
1015: // rejectPHPOnlyCreateFields keeps PHP options from silently configuring a
1016: // static or Node site.
1017: func rejectPHPOnlyCreateFields(req CreateRequest) error {
1018: 	if strings.TrimSpace(req.PHPVersion) != "" ||
1019: 		strings.TrimSpace(req.PHPBuild) != "" ||
1020: 		len(req.PHPExtensions) != 0 ||
1021: 		len(req.PHPIni) != 0 ||
1022: 		req.PHPIniRaw != "" {
1023: 		return errors.New("sites: PHP options require a php site")
1024: 	}
1025: 	if req.FrontController {
1026: 		return errors.New("sites: front controller requires a php site")
1027: 	}
1028: 	return nil
1029: }
1030: 
1031: func validateFrontControllerFile(p string) error {
1032: 	return model.ValidateSiteContracts(p, "", "", "", nil)
1033: }
1034: 
1035: func validateFrontControllerMode(mode string) error {
1036: 	return model.ValidateSiteContracts("", mode, "", "", nil)
1037: }
1038: 
1039: func validateApacheAllowOverride(override string) error {
1040: 	return model.ValidateSiteContracts("", "", override, "", nil)
1041: }
1042: 
1043: func validateSPAFallbackFile(p string) error {
1044: 	return model.ValidateSiteContracts("", "", "", p, nil)
1045: }
1046: 
1047: func validateBuildProfile(b *model.BuildProfile) error {
1048: 	return model.ValidateSiteContracts("", "", "", "", b)
1049: }
1050: 
1051: func cloneBuildProfile(b *model.BuildProfile) *model.BuildProfile {
1052: 	if b == nil {
1053: 		return nil
1054: 	}
1055: 	if strings.TrimSpace(b.Command) == "" &&
1056: 		strings.TrimSpace(b.NodeVersion) == "" &&
1057: 		strings.TrimSpace(b.Output) == "" &&
1058: 		len(b.Env) == 0 {
1059: 		return nil
1060: 	}
1061: 	cp := *b
1062: 	if b.Env != nil {
1063: 		cp.Env = cloneEnv(b.Env)
1064: 	}
1065: 	return &cp
1066: }
1067: 
1068: // applyUpdate validates and applies the partial update without touching the
1069: // store or external systems.
1070: func (s *Service) applyUpdate(ctx context.Context, current model.Site, req UpdateRequest) (model.Site, error) {
1071: 	updated := current
1072: 	if mode := model.SourceMode(strings.TrimSpace(req.SourceMode)); mode != "" && mode != current.SourceMode {
1073: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: changing source mode from %q to %q requires a source copy", current.SourceMode, mode)
1074: 	}
1075: 
1076: 	if value := strings.TrimSpace(req.Domain); value != "" {
1077: 		value = strings.ToLower(value)
1078: 		if value != current.Domain {
1079: 			if err := domain.ValidateSiteDomain(value); err != nil {
1080: 				return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: invalid domain %q: %w", req.Domain, err)
1081: 			}
1082: 			updated.Domain = value
1083: 		}
1084: 	}
1085: 	if req.WWW != nil {
1086: 		updated.WWW = *req.WWW
1087: 	}
1088: 	if req.TLS != nil {
1089: 		updated.TLS = *req.TLS
1090: 	}
1091: 	if req.ForceHTTPS != nil {
1092: 		updated.ForceHTTPS = *req.ForceHTTPS
1093: 	}
1094: 	if req.SPAFallback != nil {
1095: 		updated.SPAFallback = *req.SPAFallback
1096: 	}
1097: 	if strings.TrimSpace(req.Command) != "" {
1098: 		updated.Command = strings.TrimSpace(req.Command)
1099: 	}
1100: 	if req.FrontController != nil {
1101: 		if updated.Kind != model.SitePHP {
1102: 			return model.Site{}, errors.New("sites: front controller requires a php site")
1103: 		}
1104: 		updated.FrontController = *req.FrontController
1105: 	}
1106: 	if req.FrontControllerFile != "" {
1107: 		fcFile := strings.TrimSpace(req.FrontControllerFile)
1108: 		if err := validateFrontControllerFile(fcFile); err != nil {
1109: 			return model.Site{}, err
1110: 		}
1111: 		updated.FrontControllerFile = fcFile
1112: 	}
1113: 	if req.FrontControllerMode != "" {
1114: 		fcMode := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.FrontControllerMode))
1115: 		if err := validateFrontControllerMode(fcMode); err != nil {
1116: 			return model.Site{}, err
1117: 		}
1118: 		updated.FrontControllerMode = fcMode
1119: 	}
1120: 	if req.ApacheAllowOverride != "" {
1121: 		override := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(req.ApacheAllowOverride))
1122: 		if err := validateApacheAllowOverride(override); err != nil {
1123: 			return model.Site{}, err
1124: 		}
1125: 		updated.ApacheAllowOverride = override
1126: 	}
1127: 	if req.SPAFallbackFile != "" {
1128: 		spaFile := strings.TrimSpace(req.SPAFallbackFile)
1129: 		if err := validateSPAFallbackFile(spaFile); err != nil {
1130: 			return model.Site{}, err
1131: 		}
1132: 		updated.SPAFallbackFile = spaFile
1133: 	}
1134: 	if req.Build != nil {
1135: 		if err := validateBuildProfile(req.Build); err != nil {
1136: 			return model.Site{}, err
1137: 		}
1138: 		updated.Build = cloneBuildProfile(req.Build)
1139: 	}

173: // phpDefaultsLocked returns the editable version defaults, seeding the store
174: // from the embedded manifest on first use. Edited defaults are never
175: // overwritten by later site creation.
176: func (s *Service) phpDefaultsLocked(ctx context.Context, version string) (model.PHPDefaults, error) {
177: 	defaults, err := s.deps.Store.GetPHPDefaults(ctx, version)
178: 	if err == nil {
179: 		return s.sanitizeStoredPHPDefaultsLocked(ctx, defaults, version)
180: 	}
181: 	if !errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
182: 		return model.PHPDefaults{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: read PHP %s defaults: %w", version, err)
183: 	}
184: 	manifest, err := s.phpCatalog()
185: 	if err != nil {
186: 		return model.PHPDefaults{}, err
187: 	}
188: 	seeded, ok := manifest.DefaultsFor(version)
189: 	if !ok {
190: 		return model.PHPDefaults{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: no PHP defaults for version %q", version)
191: 	}
192: 	defaults = model.PHPDefaults{
193: 		Version:    version,
194: 		Ini:        seeded.Ini,
195: 		Extensions: seeded.Extensions,
196: 	}
197: 	if defaults.Ini == nil {
198: 		defaults.Ini = map[string]string{}
199: 	}
200: 	if defaults.Extensions == nil {
201: 		defaults.Extensions = map[string]bool{}
202: 	}
203: 	if err := s.deps.Store.SavePHPDefaults(ctx, defaults); err != nil {
204: 		return model.PHPDefaults{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: seed PHP %s defaults: %w", version, err)
205: 	}
206: 	return defaults, nil
207: }

209: // sanitizeStoredPHPDefaultsLocked removes built-in extension keys from a stored
210: // defaults row and persists the cleaned row. A row written before a line made
211: // an extension built-in (for example opcache on 8.5) must not poison every
212: // site on that line.
213: func (s *Service) sanitizeStoredPHPDefaultsLocked(ctx context.Context, defaults model.PHPDefaults, version string) (model.PHPDefaults, error) {
214: 	cleaned, dropped, err := s.sanitizePHPOverridesLocked(version, defaults.Extensions)
215: 	if err != nil {
216: 		return model.PHPDefaults{}, err
217: 	}
218: 	if len(dropped) == 0 {
219: 		return defaults, nil
220: 	}
221: 	defaults.Extensions = cleaned
222: 	if err := s.deps.Store.SavePHPDefaults(ctx, defaults); err != nil {
223: 		return model.PHPDefaults{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: sanitize PHP %s defaults: %w", version, err)
224: 	}

228: // phpExtensionDir locates the extension directory inside an installed build.
229: // Relocatable builds either keep the shared objects directly under
230: // lib/php/extensions or in exactly one architecture subdirectory.
231: func phpExtensionDir(build model.RuntimeBuild) (string, error) {
232: 	if build.Backend == model.BackendWSL || runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
233: 		return path.Join(build.Path, "lib", "php", "extensions"), nil
234: 	}
235: 	root := filepath.Join(build.Path, "lib", "php", "extensions")
236: 	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
237: 	if err != nil {
238: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: PHP build %q extension directory: %w", build.ID, err)
239: 	}
240: 	var subdirectories []string
241: 	hasSharedObject := false
242: 	for _, entry := range entries {
243: 		if entry.IsDir() {
244: 			subdirectories = append(subdirectories, entry.Name())
245: 			continue
246: 		}
247: 		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".so") {
248: 			hasSharedObject = true
249: 		}
250: 	}
251: 	switch {
252: 	case hasSharedObject:
253: 		return filepath.Clean(root), nil
254: 	case len(subdirectories) == 1:
255: 		return filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(root, subdirectories[0])), nil
256: 	default:
257: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: PHP build %q has no unambiguous extension directory under %s", build.ID, root)
258: 	}
259: }

283: // writePHPFilesLocked writes one immutable generation at sites/<id>/<hash>/.
284: // The write is atomic: files are created in a temporary directory and the
285: // directory is renamed into place. Existing complete generations are reused.
286: func (s *Service) writePHPFilesLocked(siteID string, files phpFiles) (string, error) {
287: 	siteDir, err := s.phpSiteDir(siteID)
288: 	if err != nil {
289: 		return "", err
290: 	}
291: 	generationDir, err := s.phpGenerationDir(siteID, files.Hash)
292: 	if err != nil {
293: 		return "", err
294: 	}
295: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(siteDir, 0o700); err != nil {
296: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: create PHP config directory: %w", err)
297: 	}
298: 	if phpGenerationComplete(generationDir) {
299: 		return generationDir, nil
300: 	}
301: 	// A partially written generation (for example after an interrupted
302: 	// rename or external tampering) is replaced by a complete one.
303: 	if err := os.RemoveAll(generationDir); err != nil {
304: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: remove incomplete PHP generation: %w", err)
305: 	}
306: 	temporary, err := os.MkdirTemp(siteDir, "gen-")
307: 	if err != nil {
308: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: create temporary PHP generation: %w", err)
309: 	}
310: 	defer func() { _ = os.RemoveAll(temporary) }()
311: 
312: 	if err := writePHPGeneration(temporary, files); err != nil {
313: 		return "", err
314: 	}
315: 	if err := os.Rename(temporary, generationDir); err != nil {
316: 		if phpGenerationComplete(generationDir) {
317: 			return generationDir, nil
318: 		}
319: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: publish PHP generation: %w", err)
320: 	}
321: 	return generationDir, nil
322: }

324: // writePHPGeneration writes the three generation files with their documented
325: // modes.
326: func writePHPGeneration(dir string, files phpFiles) error {
327: 	content := []struct {
328: 		name string
329: 		body []byte
330: 		mode os.FileMode
331: 	}{
332: 		{name: phpIniFile, body: files.Ini, mode: 0o600},
333: 		{name: phpFPMFile, body: files.FPM, mode: 0o600},
334: 		{name: phpHealthFile, body: files.Health, mode: 0o644},
335: 	}
336: 	for _, file := range content {
337: 		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, file.name), file.body, file.mode); err != nil {
338: 			return fmt.Errorf("sites: write %s: %w", file.name, err)
339: 		}
340: 		if err := os.Chmod(filepath.Join(dir, file.name), file.mode); err != nil {
341: 			return fmt.Errorf("sites: set %s permissions: %w", file.name, err)
342: 		}
343: 	}
344: 	return nil
345: }

378: // commitPHPFilesBestEffortLocked saves the stable copies and records a copy
379: // failure as a diagnostic event. The healthy master and its immutable
380: // generation are unaffected, so this never fails a lifecycle operation.

382: 	if err := s.commitPHPFilesLocked(site); err != nil {

387: // atomicWriteFile replaces path with data atomically.
388: func atomicWriteFile(path string, data []byte, mode os.FileMode) error {
389: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o700); err != nil {
390: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: create %s: %w", filepath.Dir(path), err)
391: 	}
392: 	temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), "tmp-*.tmp")
393: 	if err != nil {
394: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: create temporary file for %s: %w", path, err)
395: 	}
396: 	name := temporary.Name()
397: 	defer func() { _ = os.Remove(name) }()
398: 	if _, err := temporary.Write(data); err != nil {
399: 		_ = temporary.Close()
400: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: write %s: %w", path, err)
401: 	}
402: 	if err := temporary.Chmod(mode); err != nil {
403: 		_ = temporary.Close()
404: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: set %s permissions: %w", path, err)
405: 	}
406: 	if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
407: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: close %s: %w", path, err)
408: 	}
409: 	if err := os.Rename(name, path); err != nil {
410: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: publish %s: %w", path, err)
411: 	}
412: 	return nil
413: }

415: // phpGenerationComplete reports whether every generation file exists.
416: func phpGenerationComplete(dir string) bool {
417: 	for _, name := range []string{phpIniFile, phpFPMFile, phpHealthFile} {
418: 		info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, name))
419: 		if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
420: 			return false
421: 		}
422: 	}
423: 	return true
424: }

426: // phpGenerationDir returns sites/<id>/<hash>, rejecting ids and hashes that
427: // could escape the sites root.
428: func (s *Service) phpGenerationDir(siteID, hash string) (string, error) {
429: 	siteDir, err := s.phpSiteDir(siteID)
430: 	if err != nil {
431: 		return "", err
432: 	}
433: 	if len(hash) != sha256.Size*2 {

435: 	}

442: // phpSiteDir returns the per-site config directory, never the sites root.
443: func (s *Service) phpSiteDir(siteID string) (string, error) {
444: 	home := strings.TrimSpace(s.deps.Config.Home)
445: 	if home == "" {
446: 		return "", errors.New("sites: config home is not set")
447: 	}
448: 	// filepath.IsLocal accepts "." and trailing separators, which would make
449: 	// the site directory the sites root and let RemoveAll wipe every site.
450: 	cleaned := filepath.Clean(siteID)
451: 	if siteID == "" ||
452: 		cleaned == "." ||
453: 		cleaned == ".." ||
454: 		cleaned != siteID ||
455: 		!filepath.IsLocal(cleaned) ||
456: 		strings.ContainsAny(siteID, `/\`) {
457: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: invalid PHP site id %q", siteID)
458: 	}
459: 	root := config.NewPaths(home).Sites
460: 	dir := filepath.Join(root, cleaned)
461: 	rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, dir)
462: 	if err != nil || rel != cleaned {
463: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: invalid PHP site id %q", siteID)
464: 	}
465: 	return dir, nil
466: }

546: // comparePHPVersions compares dotted numeric versions component by component.
547: func comparePHPVersions(a, b string) int {
548: 	ap, bp := strings.Split(a, "."), strings.Split(b, ".")
549: 	for i := 0; i < len(ap) || i < len(bp); i++ {
550: 		av, bv := 0, 0
551: 		if i < len(ap) {
552: 			av, _ = strconv.Atoi(ap[i])
553: 		}
554: 		if i < len(bp) {
555: 			bv, _ = strconv.Atoi(bp[i])
556: 		}
557: 		if av < bv {
558: 			return -1
559: 		}
560: 		if av > bv {
561: 			return 1
562: 		}
563: 	}
564: 	return 0
565: }

571: 		return true
572: 	default:

578: // selection; the function is deliberately small.

581: 	if err != nil || parsed.Kind != "php" {
582: 		return false
583: 	}
584: 	return catalog.LineOf(parsed.Version) == line && catalog.LineOf(build.Version) == line

1515: 	}
1516: 	return errors.Join(errs...)
1517: }
1518: 
1519: // rollbackUpdate restores the old row, certificate, hosts block, and routes.
1520: func (s *Service) rollbackUpdate(ctx context.Context, old model.Site, oldHosts, oldDomains []string, certChanged bool, cause error) error {
1521: 	errs := []error{cause}
1522: 	// A failed external sync may already have copied new certificate material
1523: 	// for the same owner, so restore the old leaf even when the domain set did
1524: 	// not change.
1525: 	if certChanged || s.externalServing() {
1526: 		if _, err := s.deps.Certs.Ensure(ctx, old.ID, oldDomains); err != nil {
1527: 			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("rollback: restore certificate for %q: %w", old.Name, err))
1528: 		}
1529: 	}
1530: 	if err := s.deps.Store.UpdateSite(ctx, old); err != nil {
1531: 		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("rollback: restore row %q: %w", old.Name, err))
1532: 	}
1533: 	if err := s.syncHosts(ctx, oldHosts); err != nil {
1534: 		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("rollback: restore hosts for %q: %w", old.Name, err))
1535: 	}
1536: 	if err := s.rebuildRoutesLocked(ctx); err != nil {
1537: 		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("rollback: restore routes for %q: %w", old.Name, err))
1538: 	}
1539: 	if s.externalServing() {
1540: 		if err := s.syncVhostsLocked(ctx, ""); err != nil {
1541: 			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("rollback: restore vhosts for %q: %w", old.Name, err))
1542: 		}
1543: 	}
1544: 	return errors.Join(errs...)
1545: }
1546: 
1547: // resolveLocked resolves a site reference by id first and then by name.
1548: func (s *Service) resolveLocked(ctx context.Context, ref string) (model.Site, error) {
1549: 	ref = strings.TrimSpace(ref)
1550: 	if ref == "" {
1551: 		return model.Site{}, errors.New("sites: site reference is empty")
1552: 	}
1553: 	site, err := s.deps.Store.GetSite(ctx, ref)
1554: 	if err == nil {
1555: 		return site, nil
1556: 	}
1557: 	if !errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
1558: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: resolve %q: %w", ref, err)
1559: 	}
1560: 	site, err = s.deps.Store.GetSiteByName(ctx, strings.ToLower(ref))
1561: 	if err == nil {
1562: 		return site, nil
1563: 	}
1564: 	if !errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
1565: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: resolve %q: %w", ref, err)
1566: 	}
1567: 	return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: site %q: %w", ref, store.ErrNotFound)
1568: }
1569: 
1570: // hostsFor returns the complete hosts set: every domain of every other site,
1571: // the optional extra domains, and the dashboard's reserved host. The result is
1572: // sorted for deterministic helper updates.
1573: func (s *Service) hostsFor(ctx context.Context, excludeID string, extra []string) ([]string, error) {
1574: 	stored, err := s.deps.Store.ListSites(ctx)
1575: 	if err != nil {
1576: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sites: list sites for hosts: %w", err)
1577: 	}
1578: 	set := map[string]struct{}{dashboardHost: {}}
1579: 	for _, site := range stored {
1580: 		if site.ID == excludeID {
1581: 			continue
1582: 		}
1583: 		for _, name := range siteDomains(site) {
1584: 			set[name] = struct{}{}
1585: 		}
1586: 	}
1587: 	for _, name := range extra {
1588: 		name = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(name))
1589: 		if name != "" {
1590: 			set[name] = struct{}{}
1591: 		}
1592: 	}
1593: 	domains := make([]string, 0, len(set))
1594: 	for name := range set {
1595: 		domains = append(domains, name)
1596: 	}
1597: 	sort.Strings(domains)
1598: 	return domains, nil
1599: }

1601: // ensureDomainsAvailable rejects domains (including www aliases) already owned
1602: // by another site.
1603: func (s *Service) ensureDomainsAvailable(ctx context.Context, excludeID string, domains []string) error {
1604: 	stored, err := s.deps.Store.ListSites(ctx)
1605: 	if err != nil {
1606: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: list sites for domain check: %w", err)
1607: 	}
1608: 	used := make(map[string]string, len(stored)*2)
1609: 	for _, site := range stored {
1610: 		if site.ID == excludeID {
1611: 			continue
1612: 		}
1613: 		for _, name := range siteDomains(site) {
1614: 			used[name] = site.Name
1615: 		}
1616: 	}
1617: 	for _, name := range domains {
1618: 		if owner, ok := used[name]; ok {
1619: 			return fmt.Errorf("sites: domain %q is already used by site %q", name, owner)
1620: 		}
1621: 	}
1622: 	return nil
1623: }
1624: 
1625: func (s *Service) syncHosts(ctx context.Context, domains []string) error {
1626: 	if s.deps.Helper == nil {
1627: 		return errors.New("sites: hosts manager is not configured")
1628: 	}
1629: 	return s.deps.Helper.SyncHosts(ctx, domains)
1630: }

1632: // reserveExistingPorts restores the allocator's view of ports recorded for
1633: // persisted sites. Failures are ignored because NewService cannot return an
1634: // error; allocation still probes each candidate port before handing it out.
1635: func (s *Service) reserveExistingPorts() {
1636: 	if s.deps.Store == nil || s.deps.Ports == nil {
1637: 		return
1638: 	}
1639: 	stored, err := s.deps.Store.ListSites(context.Background())
1640: 	if err != nil {
1641: 		return
1642: 	}
1643: 	for _, site := range stored {
1644: 		for _, port := range []int{site.HTTPPort, site.FastCGIPort} {
1645: 			if port > 0 {
1646: 				_ = s.reservePort(context.Background(), site.ID, port)
1647: 			}
1648: 		}
1649: 	}
1650: }

1652: // checkDeps reports missing required dependencies in one actionable error.
1653: func (s *Service) checkDeps(needBackend, needHosts bool) error {
1654: 	var missing []string
1655: 	if s.deps.Store == nil {
1656: 		missing = append(missing, "store")
1657: 	}
1658: 	if s.deps.Certs == nil {
1659: 		missing = append(missing, "certificate manager")
1660: 	}
1661: 	if s.deps.Router == nil {
1662: 		missing = append(missing, "router")
1663: 	}
1664: 	if s.deps.Ports == nil {
1665: 		missing = append(missing, "port allocator")
1666: 	}
1667: 	if needBackend && s.deps.Backend == nil {
1668: 		missing = append(missing, "backend")
1669: 	}
1670: 	if needHosts && s.deps.Helper == nil {
1671: 		missing = append(missing, "hosts manager")
1672: 	}
1673: 	if len(missing) != 0 {
1674: 		return fmt.Errorf("sites: missing dependencies: %s", strings.Join(missing, ", "))
1675: 	}
1676: 	return nil
1677: }

1679: // NodeDefaultResolver resolves the machine-wide Node default. The tooling
1680: // package installs its ResolveNodeDefault implementation at init because it
1681: // imports sites for the PHP environment types; the local fallback below keeps
1682: // the service usable in isolation and in tests.
1683: var NodeDefaultResolver func(context.Context, *store.Store) (model.RuntimeBuild, error)
1684: 
1685: // defaultNodeSettingKey matches tooling.DefaultNodeSettingKey without creating
1686: // an import cycle.
1687: const defaultNodeSettingKey = "node_default"
1688: 
1689: // backendSpec converts a persisted site into the backend's execution view. The
1690: // exact site pin is sent for every kind; backendSpecFor additionally resolves an
1691: // inherited global default before preparing the site.
1692: func backendSpec(site model.Site) backend.SiteSpec {
1693: 	return backend.SiteSpec{
1694: 		ID:              site.ID,
1695: 		Kind:            string(site.Kind),
1696: 		Domain:          site.Domain,
1697: 		HostPath:        site.HostPath,
1698: 		BackendPath:     site.BackendPath,
1699: 		DocumentRoot:    site.DocumentRoot,
1700: 		Command:         site.Command,
1701: 		Env:             cloneEnv(site.Env),
1702: 		HTTPPort:        site.HTTPPort,
1703: 		FastCGIPort:     site.FastCGIPort,
1704: 		SPAFallback:     site.SPAFallback,
1705: 		FrontController: site.FrontController,
1706: 		RuntimeVersion:  strings.TrimSpace(site.NodeVersion),
1707: 		PHPVersion:      site.PHPVersion,
1708: 	}
1709: }
1710: 
1711: // backendSpecFor resolves the exact Node toolchain, including an inherited
1712: // global default, and returns the backend execution view.
1713: func (s *Service) backendSpecFor(ctx context.Context, site model.Site) backend.SiteSpec {
1714: 	spec := backendSpec(site)
1715: 	if toolchain, err := s.ResolveNodeToolchain(ctx, site); err == nil {
1716: 		spec.RuntimeVersion = toolchain.Version
1717: 	}
1718: 	return spec
1719: }
1720: 
1721: // ResolveNodeToolchain resolves the exact Node runtime a site shell or exec
1722: // session uses. A site pin always wins; an empty pin inherits the global default
1723: // for static and PHP sites. Node-kind sites require an explicit pin. Resolution
1724: // only considers installed builds and never downloads.
1725: func (s *Service) ResolveNodeToolchain(ctx context.Context, site model.Site) (model.NodeToolchain, error) {
1726: 	ctx = nonNilContext(ctx)
1727: 	pin := strings.TrimSpace(site.NodeVersion)
1728: 	if pin != "" {
1729: 		build, ok, err := s.findInstalledNodeBuild(ctx, pin)
1730: 		if err != nil {
1731: 			return model.NodeToolchain{}, err
1732: 		}
1733: 		if !ok {
1734: 			return model.NodeToolchain{
1735: 				Version:   strings.TrimPrefix(pin, "node@"),
1736: 				Source:    model.NodeSourceSite,
1737: 				Installed: false,
1738: 			}, &NodeVersionNotInstalledError{Version: strings.TrimPrefix(pin, "node@")}
1739: 		}
1740: 		return model.NodeToolchain{
1741: 			Version:   build.Version,
1742: 			BuildID:   build.ID,
1743: 			Source:    model.NodeSourceSite,
1744: 			Installed: true,
1745: 		}, nil
1746: 	}
1747: 	if site.Kind == model.SiteNode {
1748: 		return model.NodeToolchain{}, errors.New("sites: node site requires a version")
1749: 	}
1750: 	build, err := s.resolveGlobalNodeDefault(ctx)
1751: 	if err != nil {
1752: 		return model.NodeToolchain{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: resolve global node default: %w", err)
1753: 	}
1754: 	return model.NodeToolchain{
1755: 		Version:   build.Version,
1756: 		BuildID:   build.ID,
1757: 		Source:    model.NodeSourceGlobal,
1758: 		Installed: true,
1759: 	}, nil
1760: }
1761: 
1762: // attachNodeToolchain adds the response-only summary to a site. An unresolved
1763: // inheritance (no default at all) leaves the summary absent; a configured pin
1764: // that is missing is reported with Installed=false while the resolver error is
1765: // retained for operations that need an executable toolchain.
1766: func (s *Service) attachNodeToolchain(ctx context.Context, site *model.Site) {
1767: 	if site == nil {
1768: 		return
1769: 	}
1770: 	toolchain, err := s.ResolveNodeToolchain(ctx, *site)
1771: 	if err != nil && toolchain.Version == "" {
1772: 		site.NodeToolchain = nil
1773: 		return
1774: 	}
1775: 	site.NodeToolchain = &toolchain
1776: }
1777: 
1778: // ErrNodeVersionNotInstalled matches a site pin that does not name an installed
1779: // Node build. Create and update perform read-only validation; installing a
1780: // runtime is the explicit `runtime install` path, never a site mutation.
1781: var ErrNodeVersionNotInstalled = errors.New("sites: node version is not installed")
1782: 
1783: // NodeVersionNotInstalledError reports the exact requested pin that is not
1784: // installed.
1785: type NodeVersionNotInstalledError struct {
1786: 	Version string
1787: }
1788: 
1789: // Error implements error.
1790: func (e *NodeVersionNotInstalledError) Error() string {
1791: 	return fmt.Sprintf("sites: node version %q is not installed", e.Version)
1792: }
1793: 
1794: // Unwrap makes every not-installed pin match ErrNodeVersionNotInstalled.
1795: func (e *NodeVersionNotInstalledError) Unwrap() error { return ErrNodeVersionNotInstalled }
1796: 
1797: // resolveNodePin normalizes a requested site pin to an exact installed version.
1798: // It is strictly read-only and never asks a runtime provider to install a
1799: // missing build.
1800: func (s *Service) resolveNodePin(ctx context.Context, pin string) (string, error) {
1801: 	pin = strings.TrimSpace(pin)
1802: 	if pin == "" {
1803: 		return "", nil
1804: 	}
1805: 	builds, err := s.installedNodeBuilds(ctx)
1806: 	if err != nil {
1807: 		return "", err
1808: 	}
1809: 	for _, build := range builds {
1810: 		if nodeBuildMatches(build, pin) {
1811: 			return build.Version, nil
1812: 		}
1813: 	}
1814: 	return "", &NodeVersionNotInstalledError{Version: strings.TrimPrefix(pin, "node@")}
1815: }
1816: 
1817: // findInstalledNodeBuild resolves an exact build id, exact version, major.minor
1818: // line, or major line against installed Node builds, newest first.
1819: func (s *Service) findInstalledNodeBuild(ctx context.Context, value string) (model.RuntimeBuild, bool, error) {
1820: 	builds, err := s.installedNodeBuilds(ctx)
1821: 	if err != nil {
1822: 		return model.RuntimeBuild{}, false, err
1823: 	}
1824: 	for _, build := range builds {
1825: 		if nodeBuildMatches(build, value) {
1826: 			return build, true, nil
1827: 		}
1828: 	}
1829: 	return model.RuntimeBuild{}, false, nil
1830: }
1831: 
1832: // resolveGlobalNodeDefault selects the global Node default. tooling provides
1833: // the production resolver; the fallback mirrors its setting/newest rules.
1834: func (s *Service) resolveGlobalNodeDefault(ctx context.Context) (model.RuntimeBuild, error) {
1835: 	if NodeDefaultResolver != nil {
1836: 		return NodeDefaultResolver(ctx, s.deps.Store)
1837: 	}
1838: 	if s.deps.Store == nil {
1839: 		return model.RuntimeBuild{}, errors.New("sites: missing dependencies: store")
1840: 	}
1841: 	builds, err := s.installedNodeBuilds(ctx)
1842: 	if err != nil {
1843: 		return model.RuntimeBuild{}, err
1844: 	}
1845: 	setting := ""
1846: 	if value, err := s.deps.Store.GetSetting(ctx, defaultNodeSettingKey); err == nil {
1847: 		setting = strings.TrimSpace(value)
1848: 	} else if !errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound) {
1849: 		return model.RuntimeBuild{}, fmt.Errorf("sites: read node_default: %w", err)
1850: 	}
1851: 	if setting == "" {
1852: 		if len(builds) == 0 {
1853: 			return model.RuntimeBuild{}, errors.New("no Node build is installed")
1854: 		}
1855: 		return builds[0], nil
1856: 	}
1857: 	for _, build := range builds {
1858: 		if nodeBuildMatches(build, setting) {
1859: 			return build, nil
1860: 		}
1861: 	}
1862: 	return model.RuntimeBuild{}, fmt.Errorf("node default %q is not installed", setting)
1863: }
1864: 
1865: // installedNodeBuilds returns compatible installed Node builds, newest first.
1866: func (s *Service) installedNodeBuilds(ctx context.Context) ([]model.RuntimeBuild, error) {
1867: 	if s.deps.Store == nil {
1868: 		return nil, errors.New("sites: missing dependencies: store")
1869: 	}
1870: 	all, err := s.deps.Store.ListRuntimes(ctx)
1871: 	if err != nil {
1872: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sites: list runtimes: %w", err)
1873: 	}
1874: 	builds := make([]model.RuntimeBuild, 0, len(all))
1875: 	for _, build := range all {
1876: 		if build.Kind == "node" && nodeBuildCompatible(build.Backend) {
1877: 			builds = append(builds, build)
1878: 		}
1879: 	}
1880: 	sort.SliceStable(builds, func(i, j int) bool {
1881: 		return compareNodeVersions(builds[i].Version, builds[j].Version) > 0
1882: 	})
1883: 	return builds, nil
1884: }
1885: 
1886: func nodeBuildCompatible(backend model.BackendKind) bool {
1887: 	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
1888: 		return backend == model.BackendWSL || backend == model.BackendLocal || backend == ""
1889: 	}
1890: 	return backend == model.BackendLocal || backend == ""
1891: }
1892: 
1893: func nodeBuildMatches(build model.RuntimeBuild, value string) bool {
1894: 	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
1895: 	if value == "" {
1896: 		return false
1897: 	}
1898: 	if build.ID == value || build.Version == value {
1899: 		return true
1900: 	}
1901: 	requested := strings.TrimPrefix(value, "node@")
1902: 	if requested == build.Version {
1903: 		return true
1904: 	}
1905: 	switch strings.Count(requested, ".") {
1906: 	case 0:
1907: 		return strings.HasPrefix(build.Version, requested+".")
1908: 	case 1:
1909: 		return catalog.LineOf(build.Version) == requested
1910: 	default:
1911: 		return false
1912: 	}
1913: }
1914: 
1915: func compareNodeVersions(a, b string) int {
1916: 	ap, bp := strings.Split(a, "."), strings.Split(b, ".")
1917: 	for i := 0; i < len(ap) || i < len(bp); i++ {
1918: 		var av, bv int
1919: 		if i < len(ap) {
1920: 			av, _ = strconv.Atoi(ap[i])
1921: 		}
1922: 		if i < len(bp) {
1923: 			bv, _ = strconv.Atoi(bp[i])
1924: 		}
1925: 		switch {
1926: 		case av < bv:
1927: 			return -1
1928: 		case av > bv:
1929: 			return 1
1930: 		}
1931: 	}
1932: 	return 0
1933: }
1934: 
1935: // siteDomains returns the primary domain followed by the optional www alias.
1936: func siteDomains(site model.Site) []string {
1937: 	primary := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(site.Domain))
1938: 	if primary == "" {
1939: 		return nil
1940: 	}
1941: 	domains := []string{primary}
1942: 	if site.WWW {
1943: 		domains = append(domains, "www."+primary)
1944: 	}
1945: 	return domains
1946: }
1947: 
1948: // sameDomainSet compares domain lists regardless of order.
1949: func sameDomainSet(a, b []string) bool {
1950: 	if len(a) != len(b) {
1951: 		return false
1952: 	}
1953: 	set := make(map[string]struct{}, len(a))
1954: 	for _, value := range a {
1955: 		set[value] = struct{}{}
1956: 	}
1957: 	for _, value := range b {
1958: 		if _, ok := set[value]; !ok {
1959: 			return false
1960: 		}
1961: 	}
1962: 	return true
1963: }
1964: 
1965: func validateDocumentRoot(projectRoot, value string) (string, error) {
1966: 	root := strings.TrimSpace(value)
1967: 	if root == "" {
1968: 		root = "."
1969: 	}
1970: 	project, err := filepath.Abs(projectRoot)
1971: 	if err != nil {
1972: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: resolve project root %q: %w", projectRoot, err)
1973: 	}
1974: 	target := root
1975: 	if !filepath.IsAbs(root) {
1976: 		if !filepath.IsLocal(root) {
1977: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: document root %q escapes the project", root)
1978: 		}
1979: 		target = filepath.Join(project, root)
1980: 	}
1981: 	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(target)
1982: 	if err != nil {
1983: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: document root %q: %w", root, err)
1984: 	}
1985: 	info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
1986: 	if err != nil {
1987: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: document root %q: %w", root, err)
1988: 	}
1989: 	if !info.IsDir() {
1990: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: document root %q is not a directory", root)
1991: 	}
1992: 	if !pathWithin(project, resolved) {
1993: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: document root %q escapes the project", root)
1994: 	}
1995: 	return root, nil
1996: }
1997: 
1998: // resolveSiteDocumentRoot validates the document root in the site's source
1999: // namespace. Local sites keep the existing filesystem/symlink checks; Windows
2000: // and WSL paths are validated structurally and checked by the WSL agent when
2001: // the site is prepared.
2002: func resolveSiteDocumentRoot(site model.Site, value string) (string, error) {
2003: 	if site.SourceMode == "" || site.SourceMode == model.SourceLocal {
2004: 		return validateDocumentRoot(site.HostPath, value)
2005: 	}
2006: 	probe := site
2007: 	probe.DocumentRoot = strings.TrimSpace(value)
2008: 	if _, err := pathmode.ProxyDocumentRoot(probe); err != nil {
2009: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("sites: %w", err)
2010: 	}
2011: 	return strings.TrimSpace(value), nil
2012: }
2013: 
2014: func pathWithin(base, target string) bool {
2015: 	rel, err := filepath.Rel(base, target)
2016: 	if err != nil {
2017: 		return false
2018: 	}
2019: 	return rel == "." || (rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) && !filepath.IsAbs(rel))
2020: }
2021: 
2022: // allocatePort asks the placement provider for a backend port. Linux uses the
2023: // host allocator; Windows delegates to the WSL agent.
2024: // recordBackendHost persists the backend's routing address for this process
2025: // lifetime. The default is loopback.
2026: func (s *Service) recordBackendHost(siteID string, prepared backend.PreparedSite) {
2027: 	host := strings.TrimSpace(prepared.BackendHost)
2028: 	if host == "" {
2029: 		host = "127.0.0.1"
2030: 	}
2031: 	if s.backendHosts == nil {
2032: 		s.backendHosts = make(map[string]string)
2033: 	}
2034: 	s.backendHosts[siteID] = host
2035: }
2036: 
2037: func (s *Service) backendHost(siteID string) string {
2038: 	if host := strings.TrimSpace(s.backendHosts[siteID]); host != "" {
2039: 		return host
2040: 	}
2041: 	return "127.0.0.1"
2042: }
2043: 
2044: func (s *Service) allocatePort(ctx context.Context, siteID string, kind domain.PortKind) (int, error) {
2045: 	if s.deps.PortProvider == nil {
2046: 		return s.deps.Ports.Allocate(kind)
2047: 	}
2048: 	return s.deps.PortProvider.Allocate(ctx, siteID, kind)
2049: }
2050: 
2051: func (s *Service) releasePort(ctx context.Context, siteID string, port int) {
2052: 	if port == 0 {
2053: 		return
2054: 	}
2055: 	if s.deps.PortProvider == nil {
2056: 		if s.deps.Ports != nil {
2057: 			s.deps.Ports.Release(port)
2058: 		}
2059: 		return
2060: 	}
2061: 	s.deps.PortProvider.Release(ctx, siteID, port)

2064: func (s *Service) reservePort(ctx context.Context, siteID string, port int) error {
2065: 	if s.deps.PortProvider == nil {
2066: 		return s.deps.Ports.Reserve(port)

2074: 			return now.UTC()
2075: 		}
2076: 	}

2080: func (s *Service) emitStatus(ctx context.Context, site model.Site, old, current model.SiteStatus, detail string) {
2081: 	if old == current {
2082: 		return
2083: 	}
2084: 	from := string(old)
2085: 	if from == "" {
2086: 		from = "none"
2087: 	}
2088: 	message := fmt.Sprintf("site %s status %s -> %s", site.Name, from, current)
2089: 	if detail != "" {
2090: 		message += ": " + detail
2091: 	}
2092: 	s.emitEvent(ctx, site.ID, "site."+string(current), message)
2093: }

2095: // emitEvent records a diagnostic event. Event persistence is best effort and
2096: // never fails the lifecycle operation.
2097: func (s *Service) emitEvent(ctx context.Context, siteID, typ, message string) {
2098: 	if s.deps.Store == nil {
2099: 		return
2100: 	}
2101: 	_ = s.deps.Store.AddEvent(ctx, model.Event{
2102: 		SiteID:    siteID,
2103: 		Type:      typ,
2104: 		Message:   message,
2105: 		CreatedAt: s.currentTime(),
2106: 	})
2107: }

2110: 	if env == nil {

2112: 	}
2113: 	cloned := make(map[string]string, len(env))
2114: 	for key, value := range env {

2116: 	}

2118: }

2122: 		return context.Background()
2123: 	}
2124: 	return ctx
2125: }

2127: // defaultNewID returns a random 128-bit hex identifier. random failure is not
2128: // recoverable through this signature, so it falls back to a timestamp.
2129: func defaultNewID() string {
2130: 	var raw [16]byte
2131: 	if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
2132: 		return strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UTC().UnixNano(), 16)
2133: 	}
2134: 	return hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])
2135: }

346: // NewServer returns an API server. It never binds a socket; call Handler and
347: // serve the result on the loopback listeners or the Unix socket.
348: func NewServer(
349: 	st *store.Store,
350: 	siteService SiteService,
351: 	runtimes RuntimeService,
352: 	doc DoctorService,
353: 	logStore *logs.Store,
354: 	helper HelperClient,
355: 	cfg Config,
356: ) *Server {
357: 	if cfg.MaxBodyBytes <= 0 {
358: 		cfg.MaxBodyBytes = defaultMaxBodyBytes
359: 	}
360: 	if cfg.Logger == nil {
361: 		cfg.Logger = slog.Default()
362: 	}
363: 
364: 	s := &Server{
365: 		store:             st,
366: 		sites:             siteService,
367: 		runtimes:          runtimes,
368: 		doctor:            doc,
369: 		logs:              logStore,
370: 		helper:            helper,
371: 		vhosts:            cfg.Vhosts,
372: 		services:          cfg.Services,
373: 		serviceConfig:     cfg.ServiceConfig,
374: 		tooling:           cfg.Tooling,
375: 		build:             cfg.Build,
376: 		terminal:          cfg.Terminal,
377: 		performance:       cfg.Performance,
378: 		wslFS:             cfg.WSLFS,
379: 		cfg:               cfg,
380: 		allowedHosts:      normalizeAllowedHosts(cfg.AllowedHosts),
381: 		authToken:         strings.TrimSpace(cfg.AuthToken),
382: 		ui:                cfg.UI,
383: 		mux:               http.NewServeMux(),
384: 		logger:            cfg.Logger,
385: 		eventPollInterval: defaultEventPoll,
386: 		keepAliveInterval: defaultKeepAlive,
387: 	}
388: 	if s.services == nil && st != nil {
389: 		s.services = readOnlyServiceService{Coordinator: services.NewCoordinator(services.DefaultCatalog(), st, "")}
390: 	}
391: 	if s.ui == nil {
392: 		s.ui = ui.Dist()
393: 	}
394: 	if _, err := rand.Read(s.secret[:]); err != nil {
395: 		panic(fmt.Sprintf("api: crypto/rand entropy failure: %v", err))
396: 	}
397: 	s.registerRoutes()
398: 	return s

401: // Handler returns the fully wrapped HTTP handler. The host allowlist runs
402: // before every other layer, including authentication and static hosting.
403: func (s *Server) Handler() http.Handler {
404: 	var h http.Handler = s.mux
405: 	h = s.apiMethodErrors(h)
406: 	h = s.bodyLimit(h)
407: 	h = s.authenticate(h)
408: 	h = s.securityHeaders(h)
409: 	h = s.hostGuard(h)
410: 	return h
411: }

515: // routes returns every registered route, including UI hosting and the JSON API
516: // catch-all.
517: func (s *Server) routes() []route {
518: 	routes := s.apiRoutes()
519: 	return append(routes,
520: 		route{http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/", s.handleAPINotFound},
521: 		route{http.MethodGet, "/assets/{path...}", s.handleUIAsset},
522: 		route{http.MethodGet, "/", s.handleUI},
523: 	)
524: }
525: 
526: func (s *Server) registerRoutes() {
527: 	for _, rt := range s.routes() {
528: 		s.mux.Handle(rt.method+" "+rt.pattern, rt.handler)
529: 	}
530: }

532: // sessionResponse is returned by GET /api/v1/session.
533: type sessionResponse struct {
534: 	CSRFToken string `json:"csrf_token"`
535: }
536: 
537: func (s *Server) handleHealth(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
538: 	resp := map[string]any{
539: 		"status":  "ok",
540: 		"version": version.Version,
541: 		"helper":  "unknown",
542: 	}
543: 	if s.helper != nil {
544: 		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), time.Second)
545: 		defer cancel()
546: 		if st, err := s.helper.Status(ctx); err == nil {
547: 			resp["helper"] = "ok"
548: 			resp["helper_version"] = st.Version
549: 			if st.CAFingerprint != "" {
550: 				resp["ca_fingerprint"] = st.CAFingerprint
551: 			}
552: 		} else {
553: 			resp["helper"] = "down"
554: 		}
555: 	}
556: 	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
557: }
558: 
559: func (s *Server) handleAuth(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
560: 	if !isLoopbackRequest(r) {
561: 		writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, codeForbidden, "access denied: auth endpoint is loopback only", nil)
562: 		return
563: 	}
564: 	if s.authToken == "" {
565: 		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
566: 		return
567: 	}
568: 	supplied := r.Header.Get(authTokenHeader)
569: 	if supplied == "" {
570: 		if cookie, err := r.Cookie(authCookieName); err == nil {
571: 			supplied = cookie.Value
572: 		}
573: 	}
574: 	if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(supplied), []byte(s.authToken)) != 1 {
575: 		writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, codeForbidden, "invalid dashboard install token", nil)
576: 		return
577: 	}
578: 	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
579: 		Name:     authCookieName,
580: 		Value:    s.authToken,
581: 		Path:     "/",
582: 		MaxAge:   30 * 24 * 60 * 60,
583: 		HttpOnly: true,
584: 		Secure:   secureRequest(r),
585: 		SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode,
586: 	})
587: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
588: }
589: 
590: func (s *Server) handleSession(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
591: 	if !isLoopbackRequest(r) {
592: 		writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, codeForbidden, "access denied: session endpoint is loopback only", nil)
593: 		return
594: 	}
595: 	if s.isTLSExpected(r) && !secureRequest(r) {
596: 		writeError(w, http.StatusForbidden, codeForbidden, "HTTPS is required for dashboard session", nil)
597: 		return
598: 	}
599: 	session := ""
600: 	if cookie, err := r.Cookie(sessionCookieName); err == nil {
601: 		session = cookie.Value
602: 	}
603: 	if !isValidSessionValue(session) {
604: 		session = randomSessionValue()
605: 		http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{
606: 			Name:     sessionCookieName,
607: 			Value:    session,
608: 			Path:     "/",
609: 			HttpOnly: true,
610: 			Secure:   secureRequest(r),
611: 			SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode,
612: 		})
613: 	}
614: 	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, sessionResponse{CSRFToken: s.csrfFor(session)})
615: }
616: 
617: func (s *Server) handleAPINotFound(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
618: 	writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, codeNotFound, "API route not found", nil)
619: }

621: // settingsResponse is the public settings shape returned by GET /settings.
622: // The required controller fields are followed by the dashboard's existing
623: // identity fields so the checked-in UI can render without optional guards.
624: // MaxRequestBodyMB is the machine config value; the API transport guard is
625: // Config.MaxBodyBytes and is configured separately.
626: type settingsResponse struct {
627: 	Home                string `json:"home"`
628: 	UserHome            string `json:"user_home"`
629: 	WSLDistro           string `json:"wsl_distro"`
630: 	HTTPPort            int    `json:"http_port"`
631: 	HTTPSPort           int    `json:"https_port"`
632: 	UIPort              int    `json:"ui_port"`
633: 	AutoStartSites      bool   `json:"auto_start_sites"`
634: 	ServingMode         string `json:"serving_mode"`
635: 	ServingProvider     string `json:"serving_provider"`
636: 	GracefulStopSeconds int    `json:"graceful_stop_seconds"`
637: 	MaxRequestBodyMB    int    `json:"max_request_body_mb"`
638: 	LogMaxMB            int    `json:"log_max_mb"`
639: 	LogKeep             int    `json:"log_keep"`
640: 	RestartRequired     bool   `json:"restart_required"`
641: 	PublicPortsFixed    bool   `json:"public_ports_fixed"`
642: }
643: 
644: // handleSettings reports the machine configuration. Defaults come from
645: // config.Default; the daemon can persist runtime overrides as store settings
646: // with the same snake_case keys. max_request_body_mb is the machine setting;
647: // the API's actual request-body guard is Config.MaxBodyBytes (default 1024 MiB)
648: // and is intentionally separate. This keeps the fixed Config surface small
649: // while letting Task 17 supply the loaded config.
650: func (s *Server) handleSettings(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
651: 	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, s.currentSettings(r.Context()))
652: }
653: 
654: func (s *Server) currentSettings(ctx context.Context) settingsResponse {
655: 	defaults := config.Default()
656: 	out := settingsResponse{
657: 		UserHome:            s.userHome(),
658: 		WSLDistro:           defaults.WSLDistro,
659: 		HTTPPort:            defaults.HTTPPort,
660: 		HTTPSPort:           defaults.HTTPSPort,
661: 		UIPort:              defaults.UIPort,
662: 		AutoStartSites:      defaults.AutoStartSites,
663: 		ServingMode:         defaults.ServingMode,
664: 		ServingProvider:     defaults.ServingProvider,
665: 		GracefulStopSeconds: defaults.GracefulStopSeconds,
666: 		MaxRequestBodyMB:    defaults.MaxRequestBodyMB,
667: 		LogMaxMB:            defaults.LogMaxMB,
668: 		LogKeep:             defaults.LogKeep,
669: 		PublicPortsFixed:    s.cfg.PublicPortsFixed,
670: 	}
671: 	out.Home = s.devstackHome(ctx, out.UserHome)
672: 	if s.store == nil {
673: 		return out
674: 	}
675: 
676: 	readString := func(key string, dst *string) {
677: 		value, err := s.store.GetSetting(ctx, key)
678: 		if err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
679: 			*dst = strings.TrimSpace(value)
680: 		}
681: 	}
682: 	readInt := func(key string, dst *int) {
683: 		value, err := s.store.GetSetting(ctx, key)
684: 		if err != nil {
685: 			return
686: 		}
687: 		n, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(value))
688: 		if err == nil {
689: 			*dst = n
690: 		}
691: 	}
692: 	readBool := func(key string, dst *bool) {
693: 		value, err := s.store.GetSetting(ctx, key)
694: 		if err != nil {
695: 			return
696: 		}
697: 		parsed, err := strconv.ParseBool(strings.TrimSpace(value))
698: 		if err == nil {
699: 			*dst = parsed
700: 		}
701: 	}
702: 
703: 	readString("home", &out.Home)
704: 	readString("wsl_distro", &out.WSLDistro)
705: 	readString("serving_mode", &out.ServingMode)
706: 	readString("serving_provider", &out.ServingProvider)
707: 	readInt("http_port", &out.HTTPPort)
708: 	readInt("https_port", &out.HTTPSPort)
709: 	readInt("ui_port", &out.UIPort)
710: 	readBool("auto_start_sites", &out.AutoStartSites)
711: 	readInt("graceful_stop_seconds", &out.GracefulStopSeconds)
712: 	readInt("max_request_body_mb", &out.MaxRequestBodyMB)
713: 	readInt("log_max_mb", &out.LogMaxMB)
714: 	readInt("log_keep", &out.LogKeep)
715: 	readBool("restart_required", &out.RestartRequired)
716: 	return out
717: }
718: 
719: // devstackHome resolves the machine root for display. It follows the same
720: // precedence as config.Load: an explicit store setting, $DEVSTACK_HOME, then
721: // <user home>/.devstack.
722: func (s *Server) devstackHome(ctx context.Context, userHome string) string {
723: 	home := ""
724: 	if s.store != nil {
725: 		if value, err := s.store.GetSetting(ctx, "home"); err == nil {
726: 			home = strings.TrimSpace(value)
727: 		}
728: 	}
729: 	if home == "" {
730: 		home = strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("DEVSTACK_HOME"))
731: 	}
732: 	if home == "" && userHome != "" {
733: 		home = filepath.Join(userHome, ".devstack")
734: 	}
735: 	if home == "" {
736: 		return ""
737: 	}
738: 	if abs, err := filepath.Abs(home); err == nil {
739: 		return abs
740: 	}
741: 	return home
742: }
743: 
744: func (s *Server) userHome() string {
745: 	if strings.TrimSpace(s.cfg.UserHome) != "" {
746: 		return s.cfg.UserHome
747: 	}
748: 	if home, err := os.UserHomeDir(); err == nil {
749: 		return home
750: 	}
751: 	return ""
752: }
753: 
754: // randomSessionValue returns 32 random bytes encoded as hex.
755: func randomSessionValue() string {
756: 	var raw [sessionValueBytes]byte
757: 	if _, err := rand.Read(raw[:]); err != nil {
758: 		panic(fmt.Sprintf("api: crypto/rand entropy failure: %v", err))
759: 	}
760: 	return hex.EncodeToString(raw[:])
761: }
762: 
763: // isValidSessionValue reports whether value is a valid 32-byte hex-encoded session identifier.
764: func isValidSessionValue(value string) bool {
765: 	if len(value) != 2*sessionValueBytes {
766: 		return false
767: 	}
768: 	for i := 0; i < len(value); i++ {
769: 		c := value[i]
770: 		if !((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')) {
771: 			return false
772: 		}
773: 	}
774: 	return true
775: }
776: 
777: // csrfFor derives the CSRF token for a session cookie.
778: func (s *Server) csrfFor(session string) string {
779: 	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, s.secret[:])
780: 	_, _ = mac.Write([]byte(session))
781: 	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
782: }
783: 
784: // validCSRF reports whether token is the exact HMAC for session.
785: func (s *Server) validCSRF(session, token string) bool {
786: 	if !isValidSessionValue(session) || token == "" {
787: 		return false
788: 	}
789: 	return hmac.Equal([]byte(s.csrfFor(session)), []byte(token))
790: }
791: 
792: // isTLSExpected reports whether TLS is expected for this request's host.
793: func (s *Server) isTLSExpected(r *http.Request) bool {
794: 	host, ok := requestHost(r.Host)
795: 	if !ok {
796: 		return false
797: 	}
798: 	if host == "devstack.test" && s.cfg.Listeners.HTTPSPort > 0 {
799: 		return true
800: 	}
801: 	return false
802: }
803: 
804: // secureRequest reports whether cookies must carry the Secure attribute.
805: func secureRequest(r *http.Request) bool {
806: 	if r.TLS != nil {
807: 		return true
808: 	}
809: 	if r.URL != nil && strings.EqualFold(r.URL.Scheme, "https") {
810: 		return true
811: 	}
812: 	proto := r.Header.Get("X-Forwarded-Proto")
813: 	if i := strings.IndexByte(proto, ','); i >= 0 {
814: 		proto = proto[:i]
815: 	}
816: 	return strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(proto), "https")
817: }
818: 
819: // handleUI serves a dashboard file or the SPA entry point. Unmatched paths are
820: // application routes and fall back to index.html.
821: func (s *Server) handleUI(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
822: 	if s.ui == nil {
823: 		http.NotFound(w, r)
824: 		return
825: 	}
826: 	cleaned := path.Clean("/" + r.URL.Path)
827: 	if cleaned == "/" {
828: 		s.serveUIFile(w, r, "index.html")
829: 		return
830: 	}
831: 	name := strings.TrimPrefix(cleaned, "/")
832: 	if info, err := fs.Stat(s.ui, name); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
833: 		s.serveUIFile(w, r, name)
834: 		return
835: 	}
836: 	s.serveUIFile(w, r, "index.html")
837: }
838: 
839: // handleUIAsset serves files below assets/. A missing asset is a 404 rather
840: // than an HTML fallback, so a broken bundle is visible immediately.
841: func (s *Server) handleUIAsset(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
842: 	if s.ui == nil {
843: 		http.NotFound(w, r)
844: 		return
845: 	}
846: 	cleaned := path.Clean("/" + r.PathValue("path"))
847: 	name := "assets/" + strings.TrimPrefix(cleaned, "/")
848: 	info, err := fs.Stat(s.ui, name)
849: 	if err != nil || info.IsDir() {
850: 		http.NotFound(w, r)
851: 		return
852: 	}
853: 	s.serveUIFile(w, r, name)
854: }
855: 
856: func (s *Server) serveUIFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, name string) {
857: 	data, err := fs.ReadFile(s.ui, name)
858: 	if err != nil {
859: 		http.NotFound(w, r)
860: 		return
861: 	}
862: 	info, err := fs.Stat(s.ui, name)
863: 	if err != nil || info.IsDir() {
864: 		http.NotFound(w, r)
865: 		return
866: 	}
867: 
868: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", contentTypeFor(name))
869: 	if strings.HasPrefix(name, "assets/") {
870: 		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "public, max-age=31536000, immutable")
871: 	} else {
872: 		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
873: 	}
874: 	http.ServeContent(w, r, path.Base(name), info.ModTime(), bytes.NewReader(data))
875: }
876: 
877: // contentTypeFor returns an explicit MIME type for dashboard assets. The
878: // standard mime table is not guaranteed to know every web font extension.
879: func contentTypeFor(name string) string {
880: 	switch strings.ToLower(path.Ext(name)) {
881: 	case ".html", ".htm":
882: 		return "text/html; charset=utf-8"
883: 	case ".js", ".mjs":
884: 		return "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"
885: 	case ".css":
886: 		return "text/css; charset=utf-8"
887: 	case ".json", ".map":
888: 		return "application/json"
889: 	case ".svg":
890: 		return "image/svg+xml"
891: 	case ".woff":
892: 		return "font/woff"
893: 	case ".woff2":
894: 		return "font/woff2"
895: 	case ".ttf":
896: 		return "font/ttf"
897: 	case ".otf":
898: 		return "font/otf"
899: 	case ".png":
900: 		return "image/png"
901: 	case ".jpg", ".jpeg":
902: 		return "image/jpeg"
903: 	case ".gif":
904: 		return "image/gif"
905: 	case ".webp":
906: 		return "image/webp"
907: 	case ".ico":
908: 		return "image/x-icon"
909: 	case ".wasm":
910: 		return "application/wasm"
911: 	case ".txt":
912: 		return "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
913: 	}
914: 	if value := mime.TypeByExtension(path.Ext(name)); value != "" {
915: 		return value
916: 	}
917: 	return "application/octet-stream"
918: }
919: 
920: // writeJSON writes one JSON document with the API's no-store policy.
921: func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, value any) {
922: 	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
923: 	if err != nil {
924: 		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, codeInternal, "internal error", nil)
925: 		return
926: 	}
927: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
928: 	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
929: 	w.WriteHeader(status)
930: 	_, _ = w.Write(data)
931: }
932: 
933: // apiError is the stable JSON error envelope. Details is always present so
934: // clients can rely on a fixed shape; it is null when there is no extra context.
935: type apiError struct {
936: 	Code    string `json:"code"`
937: 	Message string `json:"message"`
938: 	Details any    `json:"details"`
939: }
940: 
941: // writeError writes the stable error envelope.
942: func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code, message string, details any) {

112: 	if id != services.IDNginx && id != services.IDApache {
113: 		return fmt.Errorf("servicecontrol: validation is only supported for nginx and apache")
114: 	}
115: 	return a.action(ctx, string(id), "validate", nil)
116: }
117: 
118: // Reload runs the catalog-pinned reload command for nginx or Apache.
119: func (a *AgentDocker) Reload(ctx context.Context, id services.ID) error {
120: 	if id != services.IDNginx && id != services.IDApache {
121: 		return fmt.Errorf("servicecontrol: reload is only supported for nginx and apache")
122: 	}
123: 	return a.action(ctx, string(id), "reload", nil)
124: }
125: 
126: // Uninstall preserves service data unless deleteData was explicitly confirmed.
127: func (a *AgentDocker) Uninstall(ctx context.Context, id string, deleteData bool) error {
128: 	config := map[string]string(nil)
129: 	if deleteData {
130: 		config = map[string]string{"confirm_delete": "true"}
131: 	}
132: 	return a.action(ctx, id, "uninstall", config)
133: }
134: 
135: // Logs reads a bounded log snapshot from the agent.
136: func (a *AgentDocker) Logs(ctx context.Context, id string, tail int) (string, error) {
137: 	if err := validateAgentServiceID(id); err != nil {
138: 		return "", err
139: 	}
140: 	if tail <= 0 {
141: 		tail = 100
142: 	}
143: 	response, err := a.api.ServiceLogs(ctx, agentAPIID(id), agentproto.ServiceLogsRequest{Tail: tail})
144: 	if err != nil {
145: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("servicecontrol: read %s logs from agent: %w", id, err)
146: 	}
147: 	return strings.Join(response.Lines, "\n"), nil
148: }
149: 
150: // Credentials explicitly reveals the agent-owned credential for supported
151: // database services. It never reads a Windows file.
152: func (a *AgentDocker) Credentials(ctx context.Context, id services.ID) (Credentials, error) {
153: 	name := string(id)
154: 	if err := validateAgentServiceID(name); err != nil {
155: 		return Credentials{}, err
156: 	}
157: 	username, port, ok := databaseCredential(name)
158: 	if !ok {
159: 		return Credentials{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: service %q", ErrCredentialsUnsupported, name)
160: 	}
161: 	field := "devstack_password"
162: 	response, err := a.api.ServiceCredential(ctx, agentproto.ServiceCredentialRequest{ID: agentAPIID(name), Field: field})
163: 	if err != nil {
164: 		return Credentials{}, fmt.Errorf("servicecontrol: read %s credential from agent: %w", name, err)
165: 	}
166: 	if response.Value == "" {
167: 		return Credentials{}, fmt.Errorf("servicecontrol: agent returned an empty %s credential", name)
168: 	}
169: 	if response.User != "" {
170: 		username = response.User
171: 	}
172: 	database := "devstack"
173: 	return Credentials{Engine: name, Username: username, Password: response.Value, Database: database, Host: "127.0.0.1", Port: port}, nil
174: }
175: 
176: // RotateCredentials delegates rotation to the agent and reveals the result.
177: func (a *AgentDocker) RotateCredentials(ctx context.Context, id services.ID) (Credentials, error) {
178: 	name := string(id)
179: 	if _, _, ok := databaseCredential(name); !ok {
180: 		return Credentials{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: service %q", ErrCredentialsUnsupported, name)
181: 	}
182: 	if err := a.action(ctx, name, "rotate-credentials", nil); err != nil {
183: 		return Credentials{}, err
184: 	}
185: 	return a.Credentials(ctx, id)
186: }

189: // and secret trees as part of its install operation; the Windows daemon never
190: // creates a local duplicate.
191: func (*AgentDocker) PrepareInstall(context.Context, services.Service) error         { return nil }
192: func (*AgentDocker) PrepareActivate(context.Context, services.Service) error        { return nil }
193: func (*AgentDocker) CommitActivate(context.Context, services.Service) error         { return nil }
194: func (*AgentDocker) CleanupActivate(context.Context, services.Service, error) error { return nil }
195: 
196: func (a *AgentDocker) action(ctx context.Context, id, action string, config map[string]string) error {
197: 	if err := validateAgentServiceID(id); err != nil {
198: 		return err
199: 	}
200: 	_, err := a.api.ServiceAction(ctx, agentproto.ServiceRequest{ID: agentAPIID(id), Action: action, Config: config})
201: 	if err != nil {
202: 		return fmt.Errorf("servicecontrol: %s %s through agent: %w", action, id, err)
203: 	}
204: 	return nil
205: }

// DefaultCatalog returns the default service catalog composed from the lane-owned
// catalog files. The lanes populate web, database, and standalone entries.
func DefaultCatalog() Catalog {
	web := webServices()
	databases := databaseServices()
	standalone := standaloneServices()

	out := make([]Service, 0, len(web)+len(databases)+len(standalone))
	out = append(out, web...)
	out = append(out, databases...)
	out = append(out, standalone...)
	return Catalog{Services: out}
}

// Get looks up a service by ID.
func (c Catalog) Get(id ID) (Service, bool) {
	for _, s := range c.Services {
		if s.ID == id {
			return s, true
		}
	}
	return Service{}, false
}

// Validate checks the catalog for internal consistency.
func (c Catalog) Validate() error {
	known := make(map[ID]bool, len(c.Services))
	for _, s := range c.Services {
		if s.ID == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("service ID cannot be empty")
		}
		if known[s.ID] {
			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate service ID %q", s.ID)
		}
		known[s.ID] = true

		if strings.TrimSpace(s.DisplayName) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("service %q: display name cannot be empty", s.ID)
		}
		if err := validateServiceFields(s); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if s.Group == GroupWeb && len(s.Ports) == 0 && s.NetworkMode != "host" {
			return fmt.Errorf("web service %q must specify ports or host networking", s.ID)
		}
	}

	for _, s := range c.Services {
		if err := validateDependencies(s, known); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// validateServiceFields applies the rules shared by catalog validation and compose
// rendering. Callers remain responsible for duplicate IDs and dependency membership.
func validateServiceFields(s Service) error {
	if !validIDRegex.MatchString(string(s.ID)) {
		return fmt.Errorf("service ID %q is invalid", s.ID)
	}

	if strings.TrimSpace(s.Image) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("service %q: image cannot be empty", s.ID)
	}
	if !validImageRegex.MatchString(s.Image) {
		return fmt.Errorf("service %q: image %q must be pinned by sha256 digest", s.ID, s.Image)
	}
	for _, arg := range s.Entrypoint {
		if strings.TrimSpace(arg) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("service %q: entrypoint arguments cannot be empty", s.ID)
		}
	}
	for _, arg := range s.Command {
		if strings.TrimSpace(arg) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("service %q: command arguments cannot be empty", s.ID)
		}
	}

	switch s.Group {
	case GroupWeb, GroupMySQLFamily, GroupStandalone:
	default:

	}

package services

import "time"

// State is the operational lifecycle state of an infrastructure service.
type State string

const (
	StateNotInstalled        State = "not_installed"
	StateInstalled           State = "installed"
	StateInstalledButStopped State = "installed_but_stopped"
	StateStarting            State = "starting"
	StateActive              State = "active"
	StateStopping            State = "stopping"
	StateError               State = "error"
)

// Record is the persistent database row describing a service's recorded state.
type Record struct {
	ID            ID
	State         State
	Image         string
	Active        bool
	LastError     string
	LastOperation string
	UpdatedAt     time.Time
}

// View combines catalog metadata and stored state for API/UI presentation.
type View struct {
	ID          ID     `json:"id"`
	DisplayName string `json:"display_name"`
	Group       Group  `json:"group"`
	State       State  `json:"state"`
	Active      bool   `json:"active"`
	Image       string `json:"image"`
	Ports       []Port `json:"ports,omitempty"`
	LastError   string `json:"last_error,omitempty"`
	ConfigPath  string `json:"config_path,omitempty"`
	DataPath    string `json:"data_path,omitempty"`
	Health      string `json:"health"`
	ContainerID string `json:"container_id"`
	Installed   bool   `json:"installed"`
}

// installedState reports whether a state implies an image and config scaffold exist.
func installedState(state State) bool {
	switch state {
	case StateInstalled, StateInstalledButStopped, StateStarting, StateActive, StateStopping:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

82: 		host := strings.TrimSpace(site.HostPath)
83: 		if host == "" {
84: 			continue
85: 		}
86: 		hostAbs, err := filepath.Abs(host)
87: 		if err != nil {
88: 			continue
89: 		}
90: 		if resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(hostAbs); err == nil {
91: 			hostAbs = resolved
92: 		}
93: 		if !pathWithin(hostAbs, absolute) {
94: 			continue
95: 		}
96: 		if _, ok := seen[site.ID]; ok {
97: 			continue
98: 		}
99: 		seen[site.ID] = struct{}{}
100: 		matches = append(matches, site)
101: 	}
102: 
103: 	switch len(matches) {
104: 	case 0:
105: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("tooling: no registered site matches %s; registered sites: %s", absolute, siteListSummary(sitesList))
106: 	case 1:
107: 		return matches[0], nil
108: 	default:
109: 		names := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
110: 		for _, site := range matches {
111: 			names = append(names, site.Name)
112: 		}
113: 		sort.Strings(names)
114: 		return model.Site{}, fmt.Errorf("tooling: %s belongs to multiple sites (%s); pass --site <name>", absolute, strings.Join(names, ", "))
115: 	}
116: }

118: func pathWithin(root, path string) bool {
119: 	rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
120: 	if err != nil {
121: 		return false
122: 	}
123: 	return rel == "." || (rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) && !filepath.IsAbs(rel))
124: }

126: func siteListSummary(list []model.Site) string {
127: 	if len(list) == 0 {
128: 		return "none are registered"
129: 	}
130: 	parts := make([]string, 0, len(list))
131: 	for _, site := range list {
132: 		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s)", site.Name, site.HostPath))
133: 	}
134: 	sort.Strings(parts)
135: 	return strings.Join(parts, ", ")
136: }

138: func validateSiteID(id string) error {
139: 	if id == "" || filepath.Clean(id) != id || !filepath.IsLocal(id) || strings.ContainsAny(id, `/\`) {
140: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid site id %q", id)
141: 	}
142: 	return nil

145: // validateEnvironment rejects names that cannot be exported safely and values
146: // that contain NUL. Callers render these entries into shell scripts (site shims
147: // and shell-init), so an unvalidated name such as "X; command" would become
148: // executable shell syntax rather than an environment assignment.
149: func validateEnvironment(env map[string]string) error {
150: 	for key, value := range env {
151: 		if !envNamePattern.MatchString(key) {
152: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid environment variable name %q", key)
153: 		}
154: 		if strings.ContainsRune(value, 0) {
155: 			return fmt.Errorf("environment variable %q contains a NUL byte", key)
156: 		}
157: 	}
158: 	return nil
159: }
