161: // BuildSiteEnv resolves the site's PHP and Node builds, writes site-scoped
162: // shims, and returns the environment for a shell or exec command. It never
163: // runs as root and never falls back to a different PHP for a site.
164: func BuildSiteEnv(site model.Site, deps EnvDeps) (SiteEnvironment, error) {
165: 	if currentEUID() == 0 {
166: 		return SiteEnvironment{}, errors.New("tooling: refusing to run a project shell as root; run devstack as the installing user")
167: 	}
168: 	if strings.TrimSpace(site.HostPath) == "" {
169: 		return SiteEnvironment{}, fmt.Errorf("tooling: site %q has no project directory", site.Name)
170: 	}
171: 	if err := validateSiteID(site.ID); err != nil {
172: 		return SiteEnvironment{}, fmt.Errorf("tooling: site %q: %w", site.Name, err)
173: 	}
174: 
175: 	if err := validateEnvironment(site.Env); err != nil {
176: 		return SiteEnvironment{}, fmt.Errorf("tooling: site %q: %w", site.Name, err)
177: 	}
178: 	env := SiteEnvironment{Site: site, ShimDir: SiteShimDir(deps.Paths, site.Name)}
179: 	values := make(map[string]string, len(site.Env)+8)
180: 	for key, value := range site.Env {
181: 		values[key] = value
182: 	}
183: 
184: 	var phpBuild *model.RuntimeBuild
185: 	switch site.Kind {
186: 	case model.SitePHP:
187: 		build, err := ResolvePHPBuild(deps.Builds, site.PHPBuild, site.PHPVersion)
188: 		if err != nil {
189: 			return SiteEnvironment{}, err
190: 		}
191: 		phpBuild = &build
192: 		hash := strings.TrimSpace(site.PHPConfigHash)
193: 		if deps.PHPInfo != nil && strings.TrimSpace(deps.PHPInfo.ConfigHash) != "" {
194: 			hash = strings.TrimSpace(deps.PHPInfo.ConfigHash)
195: 		}
196: 		if err := validateHash(hash); err != nil {
197: 			return SiteEnvironment{}, fmt.Errorf("tooling: site %q PHP configuration hash: %w", site.Name, err)
198: 		}
199: 		ini := filepath.Join(deps.Paths.Sites, site.ID, hash, "php.ini")
200: 		if info, err := os.Stat(ini); err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
201: 			return SiteEnvironment{}, fmt.Errorf("tooling: site %q php.ini is not written at %s; run `devstack site restart %s` to apply its PHP configuration", site.Name, ini, site.Name)
202: 		}
203: 		env.PHPIni = ini
204: 		values["PHPRC"] = ini
205: 	case model.SiteStatic, model.SiteNode:
206: 	default:
207: 		return SiteEnvironment{}, fmt.Errorf("tooling: unsupported site kind %q", site.Kind)
208: 	}
209: 	nodeBuild, nodeSource, err := resolveShellNodeBuild(site, deps)
210: 	if err != nil {
211: 		return SiteEnvironment{}, err
212: 	}
213: 	env.PHPBuild = phpBuild
214: 	env.NodeBuild = nodeBuild
215: 	if nodeBuild != nil {
216: 		values["DEVSTACK_NODE_VERSION"] = nodeBuild.Version
217: 		values["DEVSTACK_NODE_SOURCE"] = nodeSource
218: 	}
219: 
220: 	if err := ensureSiteShims(env.ShimDir, phpBuild, nodeBuild, env.PHPIni); err != nil {
221: 		return SiteEnvironment{}, err
222: 	}
223: 
224: 	values["DEVSTACK_SITE"] = site.Name
225: 	values["DEVSTACK_HOME"] = deps.Paths.Home
226: 	values["DEVSTACK_PROJECT"] = site.HostPath
227: 
228: 	basePATH := deps.BasePATH
229: 	if basePATH == "" {
230: 		basePATH = os.Getenv("PATH")
231: 	}
232: 	env.PATH = composePATH(deps.Paths, env.ShimDir, basePATH)
233: 	values["PATH"] = env.PATH
234: 	env.Values = values
235: 	return env, nil
236: }

238: // resolveShellNodeBuild applies the shell/exec order: the exact site pin wins,
239: // then the global default. A static build profile is deliberately ignored; it
240: // only selects the Node runtime for build execution. PHP sites without any Node
241: // toolchain still get a usable shell, and Node-kind sites require a pin.
242: func resolveShellNodeBuild(site model.Site, deps EnvDeps) (*model.RuntimeBuild, string, error) {
243: 	pin := strings.TrimSpace(site.NodeVersion)
244: 	if pin != "" {
245: 		build, err := ResolveNodeBuild(deps.Builds, pin)
246: 		if err != nil {
247: 			return nil, "", err
248: 		}
249: 		return &build, model.NodeSourceSite, nil
250: 	}
251: 	if site.Kind == model.SiteNode {
252: 		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%w: Node version is empty", ErrRuntimeMissing)
253: 	}
254: 	if deps.NodeDefault != nil {
255: 		if deps.NodeDefault.Kind != "" && deps.NodeDefault.Kind != "node" {
256: 			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("tooling: global Node default %q is not a Node build", deps.NodeDefault.ID)
257: 		}
258: 		if strings.TrimSpace(deps.NodeDefault.Version) == "" {
259: 			return nil, "", errors.New("tooling: global Node default has no version")
260: 		}
261: 		build := *deps.NodeDefault
262: 		return &build, model.NodeSourceGlobal, nil
263: 	}
264: 	return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("%w: global Node default is not configured %s", ErrRuntimeMissing, nodeDefaultRemediation)
265: }
266: 
267: const nodeDefaultRemediation = "(set a Node default with `devstack node default` or pin the site)"
268: 
269: // NodeDefaultBuild returns the installed build described by a site's global
270: // Node toolchain summary. Shell/exec callers use it to pass the resolved
271: // default into BuildSiteEnv; a nil result keeps the environment fail-closed.
272: func NodeDefaultBuild(site model.Site, builds []model.RuntimeBuild) *model.RuntimeBuild {
273: 	toolchain := site.NodeToolchain
274: 	if toolchain == nil || !toolchain.Installed || toolchain.Source != model.NodeSourceGlobal {
275: 		return nil
276: 	}
277: 	for _, build := range builds {
278: 		if build.Kind != "node" || !isCompatibleBackend(build.Backend) {
279: 			continue
280: 		}
281: 		if build.ID == toolchain.BuildID || (toolchain.BuildID == "" && build.Version == toolchain.Version) {
282: 			selected := build
283: 			return &selected
284: 		}
285: 	}
286: 	return nil
287: }

289: func validateHash(hash string) error {
290: 	if len(hash) != 64 {
291: 		return errors.New("must be 64 hex characters")
292: 	}
293: 	if _, err := hex.DecodeString(hash); err != nil {
294: 		return errors.New("must be 64 hex characters")
295: 	}

299: // ensureSiteShims writes wrappers for the site's selected runtimes and removes
300: // stale shims from a previous selection.
301: func ensureSiteShims(dir string, phpBuild, nodeBuild *model.RuntimeBuild, iniPath string) error {
302: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
303: 		return fmt.Errorf("tooling: create site shim directory: %w", err)
304: 	}
305: 	expected := map[string]bool{}
306: 	if phpBuild != nil {
307: 		for _, name := range []string{"php", "php-config", "phpize"} {
308: 			binary := filepath.Join(phpBuild.Path, "bin", name)
309: 			info, err := os.Stat(binary)
310: 			if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
311: 				continue
312: 			}
313: 			if err != nil {
314: 				return fmt.Errorf("tooling: inspect PHP binary %s: %w", binary, err)
315: 			}
316: 			if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
317: 				continue
318: 			}
319: 			script := "#!/bin/sh\nexec " + shellQuote(binary) + " \"$@\"\n"
320: 			if name == "php" {
321: 				script = "#!/bin/sh\nexec " + shellQuote(binary) + " -c " + shellQuote(iniPath) + " \"$@\"\n"
322: 			}
323: 			if err := writeScriptAtomic(filepath.Join(dir, name), script); err != nil {
324: 				return err
325: 			}
326: 			expected[name] = true
327: 		}
328: 	}
329: 	if nodeBuild != nil {
330: 		for _, name := range []string{"node", "npm", "npx"} {
331: 			binary := filepath.Join(nodeBuild.Path, "bin", name)
332: 			info, err := os.Stat(binary)
333: 			if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
334: 				continue
335: 			}
336: 			if err != nil {
337: 				return fmt.Errorf("tooling: inspect Node binary %s: %w", binary, err)
338: 			}
339: 			if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
340: 				continue
341: 			}
342: 			script := "#!/bin/sh\nexec " + shellQuote(binary) + " \"$@\"\n"
343: 			if err := writeScriptAtomic(filepath.Join(dir, name), script); err != nil {
344: 				return err
345: 			}
346: 			expected[name] = true
347: 		}
348: 	}
349: 	for _, name := range []string{"php", "php-config", "phpize", "node", "npm", "npx"} {
350: 		if expected[name] {
351: 			continue
352: 		}
353: 		if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(dir, name)); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
354: 			return fmt.Errorf("tooling: remove stale site shim %s: %w", name, err)
355: 		}
356: 	}
357: 	return nil
358: }

360: // composePATH prepends the site shim, the managed Composer wrapper, and the
361: // global PHP shims to the inherited PATH, preserving order and removing
362: // duplicates.
363: func composePATH(paths config.Paths, siteShim, base string) string {
364: 	candidates := []string{siteShim}
365: 	if info, err := os.Stat(ComposerWrapperPath(paths)); err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() {
366: 		candidates = append(candidates, ComposerBinDir(paths))
367: 	}
368: 	if info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(ShimDir(paths), "php")); err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() {
369: 		candidates = append(candidates, ShimDir(paths))
370: 	}
371: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{})
372: 	parts := make([]string, 0, len(candidates)+4)
373: 	for _, candidate := range append(candidates, filepath.SplitList(base)...) {
374: 		candidate = strings.TrimSpace(candidate)
375: 		if candidate == "" {
376: 			continue
377: 		}
378: 		if _, ok := seen[candidate]; ok {
379: 			continue
380: 		}
381: 		seen[candidate] = struct{}{}
382: 		parts = append(parts, candidate)
383: 	}
384: 	return strings.Join(parts, string(os.PathListSeparator))
385: }
386: 
387: // Environment merges values over base, replacing existing keys and appending
388: // new ones deterministically.
389: func Environment(base []string, values map[string]string) []string {
390: 	env := make([]string, 0, len(base)+len(values))
391: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(base))
392: 	for _, entry := range base {
393: 		key, _, ok := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
394: 		if !ok {
395: 			env = append(env, entry)
396: 			continue
397: 		}
398: 		if _, replace := values[key]; replace {
399: 			if _, already := seen[key]; already {
400: 				continue
401: 			}
402: 			env = append(env, key+"="+values[key])
403: 			seen[key] = struct{}{}
404: 			continue
405: 		}
406: 		env = append(env, entry)
407: 	}
408: 	keys := make([]string, 0, len(values))
409: 	for key := range values {
410: 		if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
411: 			continue
412: 		}
413: 		keys = append(keys, key)
414: 	}
415: 	sort.Strings(keys)
416: 	for _, key := range keys {
417: 		env = append(env, key+"="+values[key])
418: 	}
419: 	return env
420: }
421: 
422: // ShellExports renders sorted POSIX export statements for shell-init.
423: func ShellExports(env SiteEnvironment) string {
424: 	keys := make([]string, 0, len(env.Values))
425: 	for key := range env.Values {
426: 		keys = append(keys, key)
427: 	}
428: 	sort.Strings(keys)
429: 	var builder strings.Builder
430: 	for _, key := range keys {
431: 		// Values normally come from BuildSiteEnv/WindowsSiteEnvironment, which
432: 		// validate names. Keep this renderer fail-closed as well because callers
433: 		// can construct SiteEnvironment directly.
434: 		if !envNamePattern.MatchString(key) {
435: 			continue
436: 		}
437: 		builder.WriteString("export ")
438: 		builder.WriteString(key)
439: 		builder.WriteString("=")
440: 		builder.WriteString(shellQuote(env.Values[key]))
441: 		builder.WriteString("\n")
442: 	}
443: 	return builder.String()
444: }

206: func (m *Manager) IssueTicket(ctx context.Context, site model.Site) (Ticket, error) {
207: 	if err := m.checkUser(); err != nil {
208: 		return Ticket{}, err
209: 	}

211: 		return Ticket{}, err

216: 	default:
217: 	}

221: // Serve consumes the ticket, prepares the shell, upgrades the connection, and
222: // runs the PTY until the shell exits or the client disconnects. Errors returned
223: // before websocket.Accept are safe to render as JSON; ErrUpgrade means the
224: // handshake failed after headers may have been written.
225: func (m *Manager) Serve(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, site model.Site, token string) error {
226: 	if err := m.checkUser(); err != nil {
227: 		return err
228: 	}
229: 	if _, err := m.tickets.Consume(strings.TrimSpace(token), site.ID, m.uid); err != nil {
230: 		return err
231: 	}
232: 	prepared, err := m.prepare(ctx, site)
233: 	if err != nil {
234: 		return err
235: 	}
236: 	if err := m.reserve(prepared); err != nil {
237: 		return err
238: 	}
239: 	return prepared.serve(ctx, w, r)
240: }

242: // Close terminates every live session and waits briefly for their process
243: // groups to be reaped. Sessions observe the closure and clean up before
244: // returning, so daemon shutdown cannot leave orphan shells behind.
245: func (m *Manager) Close() {
246: 	m.closeOnce.Do(func() {
247: 		close(m.closed)
248: 		deadline := time.Now().Add(processShutdownWait * 2)
249: 		for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
250: 			if m.ActiveSessions() == 0 {
251: 				return
252: 			}
253: 			time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
254: 		}
255: 	})

353: func (m *Manager) resolveShell() (string, error) {
354: 	candidate := strings.TrimSpace(m.shell)
355: 	if candidate == "" {
356: 		candidate = strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("SHELL"))
357: 	}
358: 	if candidate == "" {
359: 		candidate = "/bin/bash"
360: 	}
361: 	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Base(candidate)) {
362: 	case "sudo", "doas", "pkexec":
363: 		// A poisoned $SHELL must never escalate privileges. Fall through to
364: 		// the safe system shells below.
365: 		candidate = "/bin/bash"
366: 	}
367: 	if path, ok := executablePath(candidate); ok {
368: 		return path, nil
369: 	}
370: 	if path, ok := executablePath("/bin/bash"); ok {
371: 		return path, nil
372: 	}
373: 	if path, ok := executablePath("/bin/sh"); ok {
374: 		return path, nil
375: 	}
376: 	return "", fmt.Errorf("terminal: no usable shell (tried %q, /bin/bash, /bin/sh)", candidate)
377: }
378: 
379: func executablePath(path string) (string, bool) {
380: 	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
381: 		return "", false
382: 	}
383: 	info, err := os.Stat(path)
384: 	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode().Perm()&0o111 == 0 {
385: 		return "", false
386: 	}
387: 	return path, true
388: }

390: func (m *Manager) reserve(session *Session) error {
391: 	m.mu.Lock()
392: 	defer m.mu.Unlock()
393: 	select {
394: 	case <-m.closed:
395: 		return ErrClosed
396: 	default:
397: 	}
398: 	if len(m.sessions) >= m.maxTotal {
399: 		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %d total sessions", ErrLimit, m.maxTotal)
400: 	}
401: 	key := siteUID{siteID: session.site.ID, uid: session.uid}
402: 	if m.bySite[key] >= m.maxPerSite {
403: 		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %d sessions for this site", ErrLimit, m.maxPerSite)
404: 	}
405: 	session.reserved = true
406: 	m.sessions[session] = struct{}{}
407: 	m.bySite[key]++
408: 	return nil
409: }
410: 
411: func (m *Manager) release(session *Session) {
412: 	m.mu.Lock()
413: 	defer m.mu.Unlock()
414: 	if !session.reserved {
415: 		return
416: 	}
417: 	session.reserved = false
418: 	delete(m.sessions, session)
419: 	key := siteUID{siteID: session.site.ID, uid: session.uid}
420: 	if m.bySite[key] <= 1 {
421: 		delete(m.bySite, key)
422: 	} else {
423: 		m.bySite[key]--
424: 	}
425: }

438: // validateSitePaths resolves the registered project and verifies that neither
439: // the project root nor the document root escaped through a symlink.
440: func validateSitePaths(site model.Site) (string, error) {
441: 	raw := strings.TrimSpace(site.HostPath)
442: 	if raw == "" {
443: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: site %q has no project directory", ErrSiteInvalid, site.Name)
444: 	}
445: 	if !filepath.IsAbs(raw) {
446: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: project path %q is not absolute", ErrSiteInvalid, raw)
447: 	}
448: 	project := filepath.Clean(raw)
449: 	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(project)
450: 	if err != nil {
451: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: resolve project path: %v", ErrSiteInvalid, err)
452: 	}
453: 	if resolved != project {
454: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: project path resolves through a symlink", ErrSiteInvalid)
455: 	}
456: 	info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
457: 	if err != nil {
458: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: inspect project path: %v", ErrSiteInvalid, err)
459: 	}
460: 	if !info.IsDir() {
461: 		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: project path is not a directory", ErrSiteInvalid)
462: 	}
463: 
464: 	documentRoot := strings.TrimSpace(site.DocumentRoot)
465: 	if documentRoot != "" {
466: 		target := documentRoot
467: 		if !filepath.IsAbs(target) {
468: 			target = filepath.Join(resolved, target)
469: 		}
470: 		target = filepath.Clean(target)
471: 		docResolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(target)
472: 		if err != nil {
473: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: resolve document root: %v", ErrSiteInvalid, err)
474: 		}
475: 		if !pathWithin(resolved, docResolved) {
476: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: document root escapes the project", ErrSiteInvalid)
477: 		}
478: 	}
479: 	return resolved, nil
480: }
481: 
482: func pathWithin(root, path string) bool {
483: 	rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
484: 	if err != nil {
485: 		return false
486: 	}
487: 	return rel == "." || (rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) && !filepath.IsAbs(rel))
488: }

82: 		}

84: 			maxChildren = pool.MaxChildren
85: 		}

88: 		}
89: 		if pool.MinSpareServers > 0 {
90: 			minSpare, explicitMin = pool.MinSpareServers, true
91: 		}
92: 		if pool.MaxSpareServers > 0 {

94: 		}

103: 	if !explicitMin {

108: 	}

115: 	if minSpare > maxChildren {

117: 	}
118: 	if maxSpare < minSpare {

130: // quote renders a php-fpm double-quoted string. Backslashes, double quotes,
131: // and dollar signs are escaped; php-fpm expands ${...} in quoted values, so a
132: // literal dollar must be written as \$. Control characters were rejected by
133: // validation.
134: func quote(value string) string {
135: 	var builder strings.Builder
136: 	builder.Grow(len(value) + 2)
137: 	builder.WriteByte('"')
138: 	for _, r := range value {
139: 		switch r {

141: 			builder.WriteByte('\\')
142: 			builder.WriteRune(r)
143: 		default:
144: 			builder.WriteRune(r)
145: 		}
146: 	}
147: 	builder.WriteByte('"')
148: 	return builder.String()

89: 	}
90: 	// The daemon builds generated paths in the Windows namespace (for example
91: 	// the site php.ini under the profile), while the agent executes in WSL.
92: 	// Translate absolute Windows arguments before handing them to the agent so
93: 	// PHPExec and other server-side commands point at the same file.

189: func toWSLPath(p string) string {
190: 	p = strings.TrimSpace(p)
191: 	if p == "" {
192: 		return ""
193: 	}
194: 	pNorm := strings.ReplaceAll(p, `\`, "/")
195: 	pLower := strings.ToLower(pNorm)
196: 	if strings.HasPrefix(pLower, "//wsl.localhost/") || strings.HasPrefix(pLower, "//wsl$/") ||
197: 		pLower == "//wsl.localhost" || pLower == "//wsl$" {
198: 		parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimPrefix(pNorm, "//"), "/")
199: 		if len(parts) >= 2 {
200: 			subPath := strings.Join(parts[2:], "/")
201: 			if subPath == "" {
202: 				return "/"
203: 			}
204: 			return "/" + subPath
205: 		}
206: 	}
207: 	if strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") {
208: 		return p
209: 	}
210: 	if len(p) >= 2 && p[1] == ':' {
211: 		drive := strings.ToLower(string(p[0]))
212: 		rest := strings.ReplaceAll(p[2:], `\`, "/")
213: 		if !strings.HasPrefix(rest, "/") {
214: 			rest = "/" + rest
215: 		}
216: 		return "/mnt/" + drive + rest
217: 	}
218: 	return strings.ReplaceAll(p, `\`, "/")
219: }
220: 
221: func toAgentSite(spec backend.SiteSpec) agentproto.SiteSpec {
222: 	documentRoot := strings.TrimSpace(spec.DocumentRoot)
223: 	backendDocumentRoot := strings.TrimSpace(spec.BackendPath)
224: 	if documentRoot != "" && documentRoot != "." {
225: 		backendDocumentRoot = path.Join(backendDocumentRoot, filepathToSlash(documentRoot))
226: 	}
227: 	proxyRoot := strings.TrimRight(spec.HostPath, `\/`)
228: 	if documentRoot != "" && documentRoot != "." {
229: 		proxyRoot += `\` + strings.ReplaceAll(filepathToSlash(documentRoot), "/", `\`)
230: 	}
231: 	mode := ""
232: 	hostNorm := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ToLower(spec.HostPath), `\`, "/")
233: 	switch {
234: 	case strings.HasPrefix(hostNorm, "//wsl.localhost/"), strings.HasPrefix(hostNorm, "//wsl$/"),
235: 		hostNorm == "//wsl.localhost", hostNorm == "//wsl$":
236: 		mode = string(model.SourceWSL)
237: 	case len(spec.HostPath) >= 3 && spec.HostPath[1] == ':' && (spec.HostPath[2] == '\\' || spec.HostPath[2] == '/'):
238: 		mode = string(model.SourceWindows)
239: 	}
240: 	return agentproto.SiteSpec{
241: 		ID: spec.ID, Kind: spec.Kind, Domain: spec.Domain, HostPath: spec.HostPath, BackendPath: toWSLPath(spec.BackendPath),
242: 		DocumentRoot: toWSLPath(backendDocumentRoot), ProxyDocumentRoot: proxyRoot, SourceMode: mode,
243: 		Command: spec.Command, Env: cloneMap(spec.Env), HTTPPort: spec.HTTPPort, FastCGIPort: spec.FastCGIPort,
244: 		SPAFallback: spec.SPAFallback, FrontController: spec.FrontController, RuntimeVersion: spec.RuntimeVersion,
245: 		PHPVersion: spec.PHPVersion, PHPBuild: spec.PHPBuild, PHPBuildPath: toWSLPath(spec.PHPBuildPath),
246: 		PHPIniPath: toWSLPath(spec.PHPIniPath), FPMConfigPath: toWSLPath(spec.FPMConfigPath), PHPHealthScript: toWSLPath(spec.PHPHealthScript),
247: 	}
248: }
249: 
250: func filepathToSlash(value string) string { return strings.ReplaceAll(value, `\`, "/") }
251: 
252: func preparedSite(resp agentproto.SitePrepareResponse, spec backend.SiteSpec) backend.PreparedSite {
253: 	host := strings.TrimSpace(resp.BackendHost)
254: 	if host == "" {
255: 		host = "127.0.0.1"
256: 	}
257: 	httpPort := resp.HTTPPort
258: 	if httpPort == 0 {
259: 		httpPort = spec.HTTPPort
260: 	}
261: 	fastCGIPort := resp.FastCGIPort
262: 	if fastCGIPort == 0 {
263: 		fastCGIPort = spec.FastCGIPort
264: 	}
265: 	return backend.PreparedSite{BackendHost: host, HTTPPort: httpPort, FastCGIPort: fastCGIPort}
266: }
267: 
268: func processInfo(resp agentproto.SiteActionResponse) backend.ProcessInfo {
269: 	return backend.ProcessInfo{PID: resp.PID, StartedAt: time.Now()}
270: }
271: 
272: func runtimeBuild(resp agentproto.RuntimeResponse) model.RuntimeBuild {
273: 	return model.RuntimeBuild{
274: 		ID: resp.ID, Kind: resp.Kind, Version: resp.Version, Backend: model.BackendWSL,
275: 		Path: resp.Path, Checksum: resp.Checksum,
276: 	}
277: }
278: 
279: func cloneMap(src map[string]string) map[string]string {
280: 	if src == nil {
281: 		return nil
282: 	}
283: 	dst := make(map[string]string, len(src))
284: 	for key, value := range src {
285: 		dst[key] = value
286: 	}
287: 	return dst
288: }

234: 		update.Env = *req.Env
235: 	}
236: 	if len(req.NodeVersion) != 0 {
237: 		// json.Unmarshal maps null (and "") to the empty string, which the
238: 		// service treats as an explicit clear for static and PHP sites.
239: 		var pin string
240: 		if err := json.Unmarshal(req.NodeVersion, &pin); err != nil {
241: 			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, codeInvalidRequest, "node_version must be a string or null", nil)
242: 			return
243: 		}
244: 		update.NodeVersion = &pin
245: 	}
246: 	site, err := s.sites.Update(r.Context(), r.PathValue("ref"), update)
247: 	if err != nil {
248: 		s.writeServiceError(w, r, err)
249: 		return
250: 	}
251: 	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, s.siteResponse(r, site))
252: }
253: 
254: func (s *Server) handleDeleteSite(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
255: 	if s.sites == nil {
256: 		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, codeServiceUnavailable, "site service is not available", nil)
257: 		return
258: 	}
259: 	if err := s.sites.Delete(r.Context(), r.PathValue("ref")); err != nil {
260: 		s.writeServiceError(w, r, err)
261: 		return
262: 	}
263: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
264: }
265: 
266: func (s *Server) handleStartSite(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
267: 	s.handleSiteAction(w, r, "start")
268: }
269: 
270: func (s *Server) handleStopSite(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
271: 	s.handleSiteAction(w, r, "stop")
272: }
273: 
274: func (s *Server) handleRestartSite(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
275: 	s.handleSiteAction(w, r, "restart")
276: }
277: 
278: // handleSiteAction runs one lifecycle action and returns 202. The action is
279: // asynchronous from the client's perspective even though the service call is
280: // synchronous.
281: func (s *Server) handleSiteAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, action string) {
282: 	if s.sites == nil {
283: 		writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, codeServiceUnavailable, "site service is not available", nil)
284: 		return
285: 	}
286: 	ref := r.PathValue("ref")
287: 	var err error
288: 	switch action {
289: 	case "start":
290: 		err = s.sites.Start(r.Context(), ref)
291: 	case "stop":
292: 		err = s.sites.Stop(r.Context(), ref)
293: 	case "restart":
294: 		err = s.sites.Restart(r.Context(), ref)
295: 	default:
296: 		err = nil
297: 	}
298: 	if err != nil {
299: 		s.writeServiceError(w, r, err)
300: 		return
301: 	}
302: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
303: }

81: 	fx := newFixture(t, Config{UserHome: t.TempDir(), AuthToken: token})
82: 	handler := fx.server.Handler()
83: 
84: 	do := func(method, path string, headers map[string]string, cookies ...*http.Cookie) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
85: 		req := httptest.NewRequest(method, "http://127.0.0.1"+path, nil)
86: 		req.RemoteAddr = "127.0.0.1:54321"
87: 		for key, value := range headers {
88: 			req.Header.Set(key, value)
89: 		}
90: 		for _, cookie := range cookies {
91: 			req.AddCookie(cookie)
92: 		}
93: 		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
94: 		handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
95: 		return rec
96: 	}
97: 
98: 	// Health stays reachable for local diagnostics.
99: 	if rec := do(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/health", nil); rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
100: 		t.Fatalf("health without token = %d body=%s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
101: 	}
102: 
103: 	// Every other API route requires the install token.
104: 	for _, path := range []string{"/api/v1/session", "/api/v1/sites", "/api/v1/services"} {
105: 		if rec := do(http.MethodGet, path, nil); rec.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
106: 			t.Fatalf("%s without token = %d body=%s", path, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
107: 		}
108: 	}
109: 	if rec := do(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/session", map[string]string{"X-Devstack-Token": "wrong"}); rec.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
110: 		t.Fatalf("session with wrong token = %d body=%s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
111: 	}
112: 
113: 	// The token header bootstraps an HttpOnly auth cookie.
114: 	rec := do(http.MethodPost, "/api/v1/auth", map[string]string{"X-Devstack-Token": token})
115: 	if rec.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
116: 		t.Fatalf("auth bootstrap = %d body=%s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
117: 	}
118: 	var authCookie *http.Cookie
119: 	for _, cookie := range rec.Result().Cookies() {
120: 		if cookie.Name == authCookieName {
121: 			authCookie = cookie
122: 			break
123: 		}
124: 	}
125: 	if authCookie == nil || !authCookie.HttpOnly || authCookie.Value != token {
126: 		t.Fatalf("auth cookie = %+v", authCookie)
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	if rec := do(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/session", nil, authCookie); rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
130: 		t.Fatalf("session with auth cookie = %d body=%s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
131: 	}
132: 	if rec := do(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/sites", nil, authCookie); rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
133: 		t.Fatalf("sites with auth cookie = %d body=%s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
134: 	}
135: 	if rec := do(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/sites", map[string]string{"X-Devstack-Token": token}); rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
136: 		t.Fatalf("sites with token header = %d body=%s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	// The SID-authenticated control pipe does not need the browser token.
140: 	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://127.0.0.1/api/v1/sites", nil)
141: 	req.RemoteAddr = "172.25.48.1:54321"

143: 	socketRec := httptest.NewRecorder()

145: 	if socketRec.Code != http.StatusOK {
146: 		t.Fatalf("socket-authenticated sites = %d body=%s", socketRec.Code, socketRec.Body.String())
147: 	}

150: func TestEveryAPIRouteRequiresTheInstallToken(t *testing.T) {
151: 	const token = "install-token-route-coverage-0123456789abcdef"
152: 	fx := newFixture(t, Config{UserHome: t.TempDir(), AuthToken: token})
153: 	handler := fx.server.Handler()
154: 	replace := strings.NewReplacer("{ref}", "probe", "{id}", "probe", "{version}", "8.4")
155: 
156: 	for _, route := range fx.server.apiRoutes() {
157: 		path := replace.Replace(route.pattern)
158: 		req := httptest.NewRequest(route.method, "http://127.0.0.1"+path, nil)
159: 		req.RemoteAddr = "127.0.0.1:54321"
160: 		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
161: 		handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
162: 		if route.pattern == "/api/v1/health" {
163: 			if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
164: 				t.Errorf("%s %s = %d, want health to stay reachable", route.method, path, rec.Code)
165: 			}
166: 			continue
167: 		}
168: 		if rec.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
169: 			t.Errorf("%s %s without token = %d, want 403", route.method, path, rec.Code)
170: 		}
171: 	}
172: 
173: 	// The token is only accepted as the header or the HttpOnly cookie, never a
174: 	// query parameter that would leak into logs and Referer headers.
175: 	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://127.0.0.1/api/v1/sites?token="+token, nil)
176: 	req.RemoteAddr = "127.0.0.1:54321"
177: 	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
178: 	handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
179: 	if rec.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
180: 		t.Fatalf("query-string token = %d, want 403", rec.Code)
181: 	}
182: 
183: 	// The WebSocket route is a GET, but it is still behind the install-token
184: 	// gate; a ticket alone is not enough to reach the upgrade handler.
185: 	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "http://127.0.0.1/api/v1/sites/probe/terminal?ticket=one", nil)
186: 	req.RemoteAddr = "127.0.0.1:54321"
187: 	req.Header.Set("Origin", "http://127.0.0.1:7070")
188: 	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
189: 	handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
190: 	if rec.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
191: 		t.Fatalf("terminal WebSocket without token = %d, want 403", rec.Code)
192: 	}
193: 	req.Header.Set(authTokenHeader, token)
194: 	req.URL.RawQuery = ""
195: 	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
196: 	handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
197: 	if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
198: 		t.Fatalf("terminal WebSocket with token and no ticket = %d, want 400 (body %s)", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
199: 	}
200: }

382: func TestAPISessionFixationProtection(t *testing.T) {
383: 	_, fx := newTestAPIWithFakes(t)
384: 	handler := fx.server.Handler()
385: 
386: 	invalidSessions := []string{
387: 		"short",
388: 		"attacker_chosen_session_id",
389: 		"0123456789abcdef", // too short (16 hex chars)
390: 		"zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz",  // 64 chars, but non-hex 'z'
391: 		"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef ", // trailing space
392: 		"../escaped/session",
393: 	}
394: 
395: 	for _, invalid := range invalidSessions {
396: 		t.Run("session_endpoint_rejects_and_reissues_"+invalid, func(t *testing.T) {
397: 			req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "http://127.0.0.1/api/v1/session", nil)
398: 			req.RemoteAddr = "127.0.0.1:12345"
399: 			req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: sessionCookieName, Value: invalid})
400: 			rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
401: 			handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
402: 
403: 			if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
404: 				t.Fatalf("session code = %d, want 200", rec.Code)
405: 			}
406: 			// When client provides an invalid session, handleSession must issue a brand-new valid cookie
407: 			cookies := rec.Result().Cookies()
408: 			var issued *http.Cookie
409: 			for _, c := range cookies {
410: 				if c.Name == sessionCookieName {
411: 					issued = c
412: 					break
413: 				}
414: 			}
415: 			if issued == nil {
416: 				t.Fatal("expected handleSession to re-issue a clean cookie for invalid session input")
417: 			}
418: 			if issued.Value == invalid {
419: 				t.Fatalf("session fixation: server retained attacker-provided invalid session %q", invalid)
420: 			}
421: 			if !isValidSessionValue(issued.Value) {
422: 				t.Fatalf("re-issued session %q is not valid", issued.Value)
423: 			}
424: 		})
425: 
426: 		t.Run("authenticate_rejects_invalid_session_"+invalid, func(t *testing.T) {
427: 			req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "http://127.0.0.1/api/v1/services/mysql/activate", nil)
428: 			req.RemoteAddr = "127.0.0.1:12345"
429: 			req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: sessionCookieName, Value: invalid})
430: 			req.Header.Set(csrfHeader, fx.server.csrfFor(invalid))
431: 			rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
432: 			handler.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
433: 
434: 			if rec.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
435: 				t.Fatalf("expected 403 Forbidden for invalid session %q, got %d", invalid, rec.Code)
436: 			}
437: 		})
438: 	}
439: }

If req.BackupFirst, call `CreateBackup` (synchronous) before drop; if job status != succeeded -> error. The backup is stored.

`EventSink.AddEvent`; model.Event fields SiteID, Type, Message, CreatedAt.

`m.logger.Info("database operation", "action", ..., "service", ..., "object", ...)`. No secrets.

  switch {

  case strings.Contains(lower,"protected"): ...
  case strings.Contains(lower,"inactive"): ErrServiceInactive
  case strings.Contains(lower,"linked"): ErrLinkedSites
  case strings.Contains(lower,"password"): ErrPasswordMissing
  }
  return err
}

Time: 2026-10-30T20:44:53.3160000+00:00
### Reasoning

Write lane report with branch, base SHA, commits, test commands/results, residual risks, Rulings.

Rulings:
1. Missing external-password platform contract: `databases.Platform` has no method to set a caller-provided password for an external user. `LinkDatabaseRequest.Password`/`SiteDatabaseRequest.Password` exist, but no platform method accepts a password. I return `ErrUnsupported` instead of silently dropping/rotating. Cost of being wrong: external user password provisioning (spec Add Site flow) is unavailable until foundation adds a `SetUserPasswordValue`-style method; users can still create metadata-only links and set the password directly in the engine. No secret loss.
2. `agentproto.SiteSpec.DatabaseLinks` missing from frozen base and owned by lane A. I added `backend.SiteSpec.DatabaseLinks` and a JSON bridge `databaseLinksPayload` in `backend/wsl` so the daemon compiles now and populates the field once lane A's `agentproto` field lands. Cost of being wrong: if lane A uses a different JSON tag/field name, Windows agent link metadata silently isn't sent, and Windows sites won't receive DB env from links (Linux unaffected). No secret leak; integration must verify and replace the bridge with a direct assignment.
3. `servicecontrol` platform adapters use a narrow `DatabasePlatformAPI` + lazy provider with runtime type assertion because `agentclient.DatabaseAPI`/`helperclient.DatabaseAPI` aren't merged. At integration, the concrete clients satisfy it; if their signatures differ, wiring returns a clear error. Cost: Windows/Linux DB operations fail closed until signatures align.
4. Uninstall link cleanup is in the API handler (`handlers_services.go`) rather than `servicecontrol.Manager.Uninstall`, because `manager.go` is not lane-owned. If a caller invokes `Uninstall` outside the API, links are not removed. Cost: stale links after non-API uninstall; UI/CLI go through API.
5. `agentproto.SiteSpec.DatabaseLinks` bridge (same as #2).

79:    flow is unavailable until a foundation amendment adds a value-setting

87:    metadata is silently omitted and Windows-linked sites get no DB env from

91:    `DatabaseAPIProvider` with a runtime type assertion to a narrow
92:    `servicecontrol.DatabasePlatformAPI`. If the merged client signatures differ,
93:    database calls fail closed with a clear error; they do not guess or panic.
94:    Cost: Windows/Linux engine operations are non-functional until lanes A/H
95:    merge, but daemon startup and all other features are unaffected.

98:    `databases.DeleteServiceLinks` after a successful `delete_data` uninstall.
99:    Cost: a non-API caller of `Manager.Uninstall` would leave links behind; the
100:    dashboard and CLI both go through the API.
101: 5. **Rename reference update added to the store.** PostgreSQL rename now updates
102:    `database_links.database_name` and `database_user_grants.database_name` in
103:    one transaction (`RenameDatabaseReferences`). If the engine rename succeeds
104:    but this store update fails, the API returns an error with the database
105:    already renamed and links stale; the engine remains authoritative and the
106:    stale links are flagged missing.
107: 6. **Task commits were combined.** Task 3 landed with the manager commit and

// CreateDatabase creates a service-wide database and audits the mutation.
func (m *Manager) CreateDatabase(ctx context.Context, serviceID string, req CreateDatabaseRequest) (model.Database, error) {
	serviceID = canonicalServiceID(serviceID)
	name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
	if name == "" {
		return model.Database{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: database name is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}
	if protectedDatabase(name) {
		return model.Database{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: database %q is protected", ErrProtected, name)
	}
	if isRedisService(serviceID) {
		return model.Database{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: Redis has no logical databases", ErrUnsupported)
	}
	if _, err := m.requireActive(ctx, serviceID); err != nil {
		return model.Database{}, err
	}
	unlock := m.lockService(serviceID)
	defer unlock()

	req.Name = name
	db, err := m.deps.Platform.CreateDatabase(ctx, serviceID, req)
	if err != nil {
		m.audit(ctx, "database.created", serviceID, "", "database", name, "failed", map[string]any{"error": safeErrorMessage(err)})
		return model.Database{}, err
	}
	if db.ServiceID == "" {
		db.ServiceID = serviceID
	}
	if db.Engine == "" {
		db.Engine = engineForService(serviceID)
	}
	m.audit(ctx, "database.created", serviceID, "", "database", db.Name, "ok", nil)
	m.emit(ctx, "", "database.created", fmt.Sprintf("database %s created on %s", db.Name, serviceID))
	return db, nil
}

package databases

// CreateBackup starts a logical backup and records its job and metadata.
func (m *Manager) CreateBackup(ctx context.Context, serviceID, database string, req CreateBackupRequest) (model.DatabaseJob, error) {
	serviceID = canonicalServiceID(serviceID)
	database = strings.TrimSpace(database)
	if !isSQLService(serviceID) {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: service %q has no SQL backups", ErrUnsupported, serviceID)
	}
	if database == "" {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: database is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}
	if _, err := m.requireActive(ctx, serviceID); err != nil {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, err
	}
	unlock := m.lockService(serviceID)
	defer unlock()

	if req.Kind == "" {
		req.Kind = model.BackupManual
	}
	record := m.newJobRecord(serviceID, database, model.JobBackup)
	return m.executeJob(ctx, record, func(jobCtx context.Context) (model.DatabaseJob, error) {
		return m.deps.Platform.CreateBackup(jobCtx, serviceID, database, req)
	}, req.Kind)
}

// RestoreBackup restores a backup to a new or existing target. An overwrite
// requires typed confirmation and a stopped-site check. A pre-restore backup
// is created first when requested.
func (m *Manager) RestoreBackup(ctx context.Context, serviceID, backupID string, req RestoreBackupRequest) (model.DatabaseJob, error) {
	serviceID = canonicalServiceID(serviceID)
	if !isSQLService(serviceID) {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: service %q has no SQL restore", ErrUnsupported, serviceID)
	}
	if _, err := m.requireActive(ctx, serviceID); err != nil {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, err
	}
	backup, err := m.backupRecord(ctx, serviceID, backupID)
	if err != nil {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, err
	}
	target := strings.TrimSpace(req.Target)
	if target == "" {
		target = fmt.Sprintf("%s_restore_%s", backup.DatabaseName, m.now().Format("20060102-150405"))
	}
	req.Target = target
	if req.Overwrite {
		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Confirm) != target {
			return model.DatabaseJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: type %q to confirm the overwrite", ErrConflict, target)
		}
		if err := m.ensureLinkedSitesStopped(ctx, serviceID, target); err != nil {
			return model.DatabaseJob{}, err
		}
	}
	preBackupID := ""
	if req.PreRestoreBackup && m.databaseExists(ctx, serviceID, target) {
		preJob, err := m.CreateBackup(ctx, serviceID, target, CreateBackupRequest{Kind: model.BackupPreRestore})
		if err != nil {
			return m.failedJobRecord(serviceID, target, model.JobRestore, "", fmt.Errorf("pre-restore backup: %w", err))
		}
		if preJob.Status != model.JobSucceeded || preJob.BackupID == "" {
			return m.failedJobRecord(serviceID, target, model.JobRestore, "", fmt.Errorf("pre-restore backup did not succeed: %s", preJob.Message))
		}
		preBackupID = preJob.BackupID
	}
	unlock := m.lockService(serviceID)
	defer unlock()

	record := m.newJobRecord(serviceID, target, model.JobRestore)
	record.BackupID = preBackupID
	return m.executeJob(ctx, record, func(jobCtx context.Context) (model.DatabaseJob, error) {
		return m.deps.Platform.RestoreBackup(jobCtx, serviceID, backupID, req)
	}, model.BackupPreRestore)
}

// ImportDatabase imports SQL into an existing database. Replace mode requires
// typed confirmation and a stopped-site check; a pre-import backup is optional.
func (m *Manager) ImportDatabase(ctx context.Context, serviceID, database string, file io.Reader, filename string, req ImportRequest) (model.DatabaseJob, error) {
	serviceID = canonicalServiceID(serviceID)
	database = strings.TrimSpace(database)
	if !isSQLService(serviceID) {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: service %q has no SQL import", ErrUnsupported, serviceID)
	}
	if database == "" {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: database is required", ErrInvalidRequest)
	}
	if req.Mode == "" {
		req.Mode = ImportMerge
	}
	if req.Mode != ImportMerge && req.Mode != ImportReplace {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: import mode %q", ErrInvalidRequest, req.Mode)
	}
	if _, err := m.requireActive(ctx, serviceID); err != nil {
		return model.DatabaseJob{}, err
	}
	if req.Mode == ImportReplace {
		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Confirm) != database {
			return model.DatabaseJob{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: type %q to confirm replacing the database contents", ErrConflict, database)
		}
		if err := m.ensureLinkedSitesStopped(ctx, serviceID, database); err != nil {
			return model.DatabaseJob{}, err
		}
	}
	preBackupID := ""
	if req.PreImportBackup {
		preJob, err := m.CreateBackup(ctx, serviceID, database, CreateBackupRequest{Kind: model.BackupPreImport})
		if err != nil {
			return m.failedJobRecord(serviceID, database, model.JobImport, "", fmt.Errorf("pre-import backup: %w", err))

Uniqueness and\n// foreign-key failures are reported as ErrConflict so callers can map races to\n// a stable conflict instead of an internal error.\nfunc (s *Store) CreateDatabaseLink(ctx context.Context, link model.DatabaseLinkRecord) error {\n\ttx, err := s.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create database link %q: begin transaction: %w\", link.ID, err)\n\t}\n\tdefer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()\n\tif link.Primary {\n\t\tif _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE database_links SET is_primary = 0 WHERE site_id = ?`, link.SiteID); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"clear primary database link for site %q: %w\", link.SiteID, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO database_links (`+databaseLinkColumns+`)\n\t\tVALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n\t\tlink.ID, link.SiteID, link.ServiceID, link.DatabaseName, link.UserID,\n\t\tboolInt(link.Primary), link.CreatedAt); err != nil {\n\t\tif isConstraintError(err) {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create database link %q: %w\", link.ID, ErrConflict)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create database link %q: %w\", link.ID, err)\n\t}\n\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create database link %q: commit: %w\", link.ID, err)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}"

// user remain service-wide.
func (s *Service) linkProvisionedDatabase(ctx context.Context, site model.Site, provisioned *databases.ProvisionedDatabase) {
	if provisioned == nil || s.deps.Database == nil {
		return
	}
	if _, err := s.deps.Database.LinkProvisioned(ctx, site.ID, *provisioned); err != nil {
		s.emitEvent(ctx, site.ID, "database.link.changed", fmt.Sprintf("site %s: link database: %v", site.Name, err))
	}
}

// checkDatabaseGuard blocks a start when a linked service has a conflicting
// exclusive-group engine active.
func (s *Service) checkDatabaseGuard(ctx context.Context, site model.Site) error {
	if s.deps.DatabaseGuard == nil {
	if s.deps.DatabaseEnv == nil {
		return nil
	}
	env, err := s.deps.DatabaseEnv(ctx, site)
	if err != nil {
		s.emitEvent(ctx, site.ID, "database.service.offline", fmt.Sprintf("site %s: resolve database environment: %v", site.Name, err))
		return nil
	}
	return env
}

770: 	}
771: 	return mergedEnv(siteEnv, callEnv)
772: }
773: 
774: // mergedEnv layers the site environment and per-call environment over the
775: // daemon's environment.
776: func mergedEnv(siteEnv, callEnv map[string]string) map[string]string {
777: 	values := make(map[string]string, len(os.Environ())+len(siteEnv)+len(callEnv))
778: 	for _, entry := range os.Environ() {
779: 		key, value, ok := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
780: 		if !ok {
781: 			continue
782: 		}
783: 		values[key] = value
784: 	}
785: 	for key, value := range siteEnv {
786: 		values[key] = value
787: 	}
788: 	for key, value := range callEnv {
789: 		values[key] = value
790: 	}
791: 	return values
792: }

func (s *Server) handleSetServiceUserPassword(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if s.databaseUnavailable(w) {
		return
	}
	secret, err := s.databases.SetUserPassword(r.Context(), r.PathValue("id"), r.PathValue("userID"))
	if err != nil {
		s.writeServiceError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, secret)
}

	if s.databaseUnavailable(w) {

	}

	if err != nil {

	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, secret)

	}

	if err != nil {

	if s.databaseUnavailable(w) {
		return
	}
	env, err := s.databases.SiteDatabaseEnv(r.Context(), r.PathValue("ref"))

		s.writeServiceError(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if env == nil {
		env = map[string]string{}
	}
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"env": env})
}

The full re-audit still returned **not merge-ready**: 1 Critical, 5 Important, plus a pending env-persistence fix. Fix them test-first (RED then GREEN), commit each logical fix separately, and update `.superpowers/lane-report.md`. Do not merge, push, rebase, or dispatch subagents.

## Critical finding

**C-1. Multi-service primary env is wrong/nondeterministic.**
`Manager.SiteDatabaseEnv` (`links.go:272-287`) groups links by service and calls `Platform.ResolveSiteEnv` per group. Each platform decides ÔÇ£primaryÔÇØ from the slice it receives; a group with only non-primary links falls back to index 0, emitting `DB_*`, and the daemon merges per-service maps in random Go map order. A site linked to `mysql/app` (primary) and `postgresql/analytics` (non-primary) can get `DB_DATABASE=analytics`.
Fix lane-locally without a foundation amendment: resolve with global primary context. Recommended approach: identify the true primary link globally; call `Platform.ResolveSiteEnv` with exactly one link per call; for the primary link keep the returned `DB_*` keys; for each non-primary link take the platformÔÇÖs `DB_*` result and re-key it to the `DB_<SLUG>_*` names already defined by `SiteEnv`/`envSlug` (including mapping `DATABASE_URL` to the namespaced URL key). Merge deterministically. Add a test with links on two services that asserts `DB_DATABASE` is the true primary and non-primary values are `DB_<SLUG>_*`, repeated enough to catch map-order nondeterminism. If a cleaner `PrimaryLinkID` request field is needed, request a controller amendment instead of editing the frozen `dbproto` contract unilaterally.

## Important findings

**I-1. ÔÇ£Background jobsÔÇØ are synchronous; 202/cancel/progress are not real.**
`executeJob` (`jobs.go:192-271`) runs `fn` inline; the HTTP handler writes 202 only after completion, so a 1 GiB import blocks the request and `DELETE /jobs/{id}` is unusable.
Fix: run the job in a goroutine with a detached context (or a per-job cancellable context stored in `m.cancels`); return the queued/running job immediately with 202; make `GetJob` read the daemon store (the platform `GetJob` stubs are not usable); implement `CancelJob` via the stored cancel func and mark only queued/running jobs canceled. For import, stage the uploaded file to a temp file synchronously before returning, have the goroutine read it, and clean it up. Move pre-operation backups into the goroutine after synchronous validation. Add tests: a blocking fake platform returns before the handler completes; mid-flight cancel; import staging cleanup.
If you conclude async is not feasible in this round, you must explicitly request a controller ruling to document synchronous jobs as a v1 limitation ÔÇö do not silently keep the current 202-after-completion behavior.

**I-2. Redaction is incomplete.**
`redact.go:12-15` uses `\b` and only `=`; `DB_PASSWORD=s3cret`, `APP_SECRET=s3cret`, and `password: s3cret` are not redacted. `GetJob` copies `platformJob.Message` unredacted; `ListBackups` returns `DatabaseBackup.Error` unredacted; `Impact`/`backupFromView`/`backupToView` return stored errors unredacted. Broaden the pattern to prefixed keys and `:` separators (or share one redactor), redact at every view/persist boundary, and add tests for `DB_PASSWORD=`, `password:`, and a DSN-bearing backup error.

**I-3. Add Site link failure is silent.**
`linkProvisionedDatabase` (`sites/service.go:2186-2196`) returns nothing and only emits an event; the API returns 201 with no warning. Add an additive `Warnings []string` field to `model.Site` (controller-approved) or a response wrapper, populate it when linking fails after the site row is created, and assert it in `TestCreateLinkFailureKeepsSiteAndWarns`. Keep the site and the created database/user.

**I-4. Uninstall cleanup is not one transaction and failures are swallowed.**
`handlers_services.go:124-133` calls `DeleteServiceLinks` then `DeleteServiceMetadata`, logs errors, and returns 200; `DeleteServiceMetadata` already deletes links. Call only `DeleteServiceMetadata` (or a single manager method), emit `database.link.changed` with the removed count, and surface a warning/error if cleanup fails. Add a failure-path test.

**I-5. Pre-operation backup and destructive operation are not in one service critical section.**
`RestoreBackup`/`ImportDatabase`/`DropDatabase` create the pre-op backup before acquiring `lockService`; another mutation can run in between. Add a lock-held `createBackupLocked` path and hold the service lock across the stopped-site check + pre-op backup + destructive platform call. Avoid nested locking/deadlock; add a concurrency test.

## Pending env-persistence fix

`sites/service.go:1774-1779` still merges resolved `databaseEnv` into `spec.Env` for non-PHP sites. Lane A now strips reserved `DB_*`/`DATABASE_URL` keys defensively, so Windows sites would silently lose DB env. Stop writing secrets to `spec.Env`: use `spec.RuntimeEnv` for Linux process env and `SiteSpec.DatabaseLinks` for Windows normal starts; reserve `/database-env` for explicit resolution. Add tests proving `sites.json`/`php-fpm.conf` never contain a DB password and that Node/static sites still receive DB env on both platforms.

// newJobRecord creates a queued job row.
func (m *Manager) newJobRecord(serviceID, database string, kind model.DatabaseJobKind) model.DatabaseJobRecord {
	now := m.now().Unix()
	record := model.DatabaseJobRecord{
		ID:           m.newID("job"),
		ServiceID:    serviceID,
		DatabaseName: database,
		Kind:         string(kind),
		Status:       string(model.JobQueued),
		CreatedAt:    now,
		UpdatedAt:    now,
	}
	_ = m.deps.Store.CreateDatabaseJob(context.Background(), record)
	return record
}

// failedJobRecord creates and persists a failed job without calling the
// platform. It is used when a pre-operation backup cannot be made.
func (m *Manager) failedJobRecord(serviceID, database string, kind model.DatabaseJobKind, backupID string, cause error) (model.DatabaseJob, error) {
	record := m.newJobRecord(serviceID, database, kind)
	record.Status = string(model.JobFailed)
	record.BackupID = backupID
	record.Message = safeErrorMessage(cause)
	record.UpdatedAt = m.now().Unix()
	_ = m.deps.Store.UpdateDatabaseJob(context.Background(), record)
	job := recordToJob(record)
	m.auditJob(context.Background(), job, "failed")
	return job, cause
}

// executeJob runs one platform operation while tracking its queued/running/
// terminal states. Platform calls may themselves be asynchronous; a completed
// platform job is recorded as succeeded, a failed one as failed.
func (m *Manager) executeJob(ctx context.Context, record model.DatabaseJobRecord, fn func(context.Context) (model.DatabaseJob, error), backupKind model.DatabaseBackupKind) (model.DatabaseJob, error) {
	jobCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	m.jobsMu.Lock()
	m.cancels[record.ID] = cancel
	m.jobsMu.Unlock()
	defer func() {
		cancel()
		m.jobsMu.Lock()
		delete(m.cancels, record.ID)
		m.jobsMu.Unlock()
	}()

	record.Status = string(model.JobRunning)
	record.UpdatedAt = m.now().Unix()
	if err := m.deps.Store.UpdateDatabaseJob(context.Background(), record); err != nil {
		return recordToJob(record), err
	}
	job := recordToJob(record)
	m.emit(ctx, "", "database.job.updated", fmt.Sprintf("database job %s running", job.ID))

	result, err := fn(jobCtx)
	if result.ID != "" {
		m.jobsMu.Lock()
		m.platformJobs[record.ID] = result.ID
		m.jobsMu.Unlock()
	}
	if result.Status != "" {
		job.Status = result.Status
	}
	if result.Progress > 0 {
		job.Progress = result.Progress
	}
	if result.Message != "" {
		job.Message = RedactString(result.Message)
	}
	if result.BackupID != "" {
		job.BackupID = result.BackupID
	}
	if err != nil || job.Status == model.JobFailed {
		if errors.Is(jobCtx.Err(), context.Canceled) {
			job.Status = model.JobCanceled
		} else {
			job.Status = model.JobFailed
			if job.Message == "" {
				job.Message = safeErrorMessage(err)
			}
		}
		job.UpdatedAt = m.now()
		record = jobToRecord(job)
		_ = m.deps.Store.UpdateDatabaseJob(context.Background(), record)
		m.emit(context.Background(), "", "database.job.updated", fmt.Sprintf("database job %s %s", job.ID, job.Status))
		m.emitJobEvent(context.Background(), job)
		m.auditJob(context.Background(), job, string(job.Status))
		if err == nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("%w: database job %s %s: %s", ErrConflict, job.ID, job.Status, job.Message)
		}
		return job, err
	}
	if job.Status == model.JobRunning || job.Status == model.JobQueued {
		// The platform started an asynchronous job. Keep the daemon job running;
		// GetJob refreshes it from the platform.
		job.UpdatedAt = m.now()
		record = jobToRecord(job)
		_ = m.deps.Store.UpdateDatabaseJob(context.Background(), record)
		m.emit(context.Background(), "", "database.job.updated", fmt.Sprintf("database job %s running", job.ID))
		return job, nil
	}
	job.Status = model.JobSucceeded
	job.Progress = 100
	job.UpdatedAt = m.now()
	record = jobToRecord(job)
	_ = m.deps.Store.UpdateDatabaseJob(context.Background(), record)
	if job.BackupID != "" {
		m.recordBackupMetadata(ctx, record.ServiceID, record.DatabaseName, job.BackupID, backupKind)
	}
	m.emit(context.Background(), "", "database.job.updated", fmt.Sprintf("database job %s succeeded", job.ID))
	m.emitJobEvent(context.Background(), job)
	m.auditJob(context.Background(), job, "ok")
	return job, nil
}

// emitJobEvent publishes the domain-specific SSE name in addition to the
// generic job update.
func (m *Manager) emitJobEvent(ctx context.Context, job model.DatabaseJob) {
	switch job.Kind {
	case model.JobBackup:
		m.emit(ctx, "", "database.backup.created", fmt.Sprintf("database backup %s for %s on %s", job.BackupID, job.Database, job.ServiceID))
	case model.JobRestore:
		m.emit(ctx, "", "database.backup.restored", fmt.Sprintf("database %s restored on %s", job.Database, job.ServiceID))
	case model.JobImport:
		m.emit(ctx, "", "database.import.completed", fmt.Sprintf("database %s import completed on %s", job.Database, job.ServiceID))
	}
}

// auditJob writes the durable audit row for one terminal job state.
func (m *Manager) auditJob(ctx context.Context, job model.DatabaseJob, result string) {

	case model.JobBackup:
package databases

import (
	"regexp"
	"strings"
)

// Redaction patterns cover the credential shapes engine tools and connection
// strings commonly put in error messages. The manager redacts at its boundary
// so no secret reaches audit rows, job rows, events, or API responses.
var redactionPatterns = []*regexp.Regexp{
	regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b(password|passwd|pwd|secret|token)\s*=\s*[^\s;&"']+`),
	regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b(pgpassword|mysql_pwd)\s*=\s*[^\s;&"']+`),
	regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b(mysql|mariadb|postgres|postgresql|redis)://[^@\s/]+@`),
	regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://[^/\s:@]+:[^@\s/]+@`),
}

// RedactString removes credential values from one message.
func RedactString(value string) string {
	redacted := value
	for _, pattern := range redactionPatterns {
		redacted = pattern.ReplaceAllStringFunc(redacted, func(match string) string {
			lower := strings.ToLower(match)
			if strings.Contains(lower, "://") {
				index := strings.Index(match, "://")
				return match[:index+3] + "***@"
			}
			if index := strings.IndexAny(match, "=:"); index >= 0 {
				return match[:index+1] + "***"
			}
			return "***"
		})
	}
	return redacted
}

// RedactError returns a redacted error message, or an empty string for nil.
func RedactError(err error) string {
	if err == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return RedactString(err.Error())
}

// ExportDatabase streams a logical dump.
func (m *Manager) ExportDatabase(ctx context.Context, serviceID, database string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
	serviceID = canonicalServiceID(serviceID)
	if !isSQLService(serviceID) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: service %q has no SQL export", ErrUnsupported, serviceID)
	}
	if _, err := m.requireActive(ctx, serviceID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	reader, err := m.deps.Platform.ExportDatabase(ctx, serviceID, database)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	m.audit(ctx, "database.export.started", serviceID, "", "database", database, "ok", nil)
	m.emit(ctx, "", "database.export.started", fmt.Sprintf("database %s export started on %s", database, serviceID))
	return reader, nil
}

// DropDatabase drops a database after typed confirmation and a stopped-site
// check. BackupFirst creates a pre_drop backup before the engine mutation.
func (m *Manager) DropDatabase(ctx context.Context, serviceID, name string, req DropDatabaseRequest) error {
	serviceID = canonicalServiceID(serviceID)
	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if !isSQLService(serviceID) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: service %q has no logical databases", ErrUnsupported, serviceID)
	}
	if protectedDatabase(name) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: database %q is protected", ErrProtected, name)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(req.Confirm) != name {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: type %q to confirm the drop", ErrConflict, name)
	}
	if _, err := m.requireActive(ctx, serviceID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := m.ensureLinkedSitesStopped(ctx, serviceID, name); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if req.BackupFirst {
		job, err := m.CreateBackup(ctx, serviceID, name, CreateBackupRequest{Kind: model.BackupPreDrop})
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("backup before drop: %w", err)
		}
		if job.Status != model.JobSucceeded {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: backup before drop did not succeed: %s", ErrConflict, job.Message)
		}
	}
	unlock := m.lockService(serviceID)
	defer unlock()
	if err := m.deps.Platform.DropDatabase(ctx, serviceID, name, req); err != nil {
		m.audit(ctx, "database.dropped", serviceID, "", "database", name, "failed", map[string]any{"error": safeErrorMessage(err)})
		return err
	}
	m.audit(ctx, "database.dropped", serviceID, "", "database", name, "ok", nil)
	m.emit(ctx, "", "database.dropped", fmt.Sprintf("database %s dropped on %s", name, serviceID))
	return nil
}
